desc.en: Anthropic's agentic coding tool for terminal, IDE, desktop and web; repo hosts issues, changelog, plugins and example configs.
desc.zh: Anthropic 官方智能体编程工具，支持终端、IDE、桌面与网页；仓库包含问题反馈、更新日志、插件和示例配置。

desc.en: Official GitHub Action that runs Claude Code on PRs and issues: responds to @claude mentions, reviews code and implements changes.
desc.zh: 官方 GitHub Action，在 PR 和 Issue 中运行 Claude Code：响应 @claude 提及、审查代码并实现修改。

desc.en: Anthropic's public repository of Agent Skills, including document skills (docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf), examples and the skill-creator.
desc.zh: Anthropic 官方 Agent Skills 公共仓库，包含文档类技能（docx、pptx、xlsx、pdf）、示例及 skill-creator。

desc.en: Official notebooks and recipes for building with Claude: tool use, RAG, agents, Agent SDK, Managed Agents, skills, evals, multimodal.
desc.zh: 官方 Notebook 与示例集，涵盖工具调用、RAG、智能体、Agent SDK、Managed Agents、技能、评测与多模态。

desc.en: Deployable starter apps built on the Claude API, such as a customer support agent, financial analyst, computer-use and autonomous coding demos.
desc.zh: 基于 Claude API 的可部署入门项目，如客服智能体、金融分析、Computer Use 与自主编程演示。

desc.en: Anthropic-managed marketplace of curated Claude Code plugins bundling skills, subagents, hooks and MCP servers.
desc.zh: Anthropic 官方维护的 Claude Code 插件市场，收录集成技能、子代理、钩子与 MCP 服务器的精选插件。

desc.en: Official open-source plugins for knowledge workers using Claude Cowork, covering sales, finance, legal, support, marketing and more.
desc.zh: 面向知识工作者的官方开源插件集，用于 Claude Cowork，覆盖销售、财务、法务、客服、市场等场景。

desc.en: Reference agents, skills and data connectors for finance workflows, installable as Cowork plugins or deployable via Managed Agents.
desc.zh: 面向金融业务的参考智能体、技能和数据连接器，可作为 Cowork 插件安装或通过 Managed Agents 部署。

desc.en: GitHub Action that uses Claude to analyze code changes for security vulnerabilities and comment findings on pull requests.
desc.zh: 使用 Claude 分析代码变更安全漏洞并在 PR 中评论结果的 GitHub Action。

desc.en: Lightweight OS-level sandbox enforcing filesystem and network restrictions on agents, MCP servers and commands without containers; built for Claude Code.
desc.zh: 轻量级系统级沙箱，无需容器即可对智能体、MCP 服务器和命令施加文件系统与网络限制；为 Claude Code 打造。

desc.en: Official Dev Container Features for installing the Claude Code CLI into devcontainers and Codespaces.
desc.zh: 官方 Dev Container Features，可将 Claude Code CLI 安装到开发容器与 Codespaces 中。

desc.en: Claude Code skills for threat modeling, scanning, triage and patching, plus an autonomous recon-find-verify-report-patch security harness.
desc.zh: 用于威胁建模、漏洞扫描、分诊与修补的 Claude Code 技能，以及自主化的安全扫描参考框架。

desc.en: Specification and documentation source for MCP, the open protocol Anthropic created for connecting AI apps to tools and data.
desc.zh: MCP 规范与文档源码；MCP 是 Anthropic 发起、用于连接 AI 应用与工具和数据的开放协议。

desc.en: Python SDK exposing Claude Code's agent loop, built-in tools, hooks, subagents, MCP and permissions for building custom agents.
desc.zh: Python 版 Agent SDK，提供 Claude Code 的智能体循环、内置工具、钩子、子代理、MCP 与权限控制，用于构建自定义智能体。

desc.en: TypeScript SDK for building production agents on the same harness, tools and context management that power Claude Code.
desc.zh: TypeScript 版 Agent SDK，基于驱动 Claude Code 的同一套框架、工具与上下文管理构建生产级智能体。

desc.en: Official Python client library for the Claude API, with sync/async clients, streaming, tool use helpers and the beta tool runner.
desc.zh: Claude API 官方 Python 客户端库，支持同步/异步、流式输出、工具调用辅助及 beta 版 tool runner。

desc.en: Official TypeScript/JavaScript client for the Claude API (@anthropic-ai/sdk), supporting Node, Deno, Bun and edge runtimes.
desc.zh: Claude API 官方 TypeScript/JavaScript 客户端（@anthropic-ai/sdk），支持 Node、Deno、Bun 与边缘运行时。

desc.en: Official Go client library for the Claude API.
desc.zh: Claude API 官方 Go 客户端库。

desc.en: Official Java (and Kotlin-friendly) client library for the Claude API.
desc.zh: Claude API 官方 Java 客户端库（亦适用于 Kotlin）。

desc.en: Official C#/.NET client library for the Claude API.
desc.zh: Claude API 官方 C#/.NET 客户端库。

desc.en: Official Ruby client library for the Claude API.
desc.zh: Claude API 官方 Ruby 客户端库。

desc.en: Official PHP client library for the Claude API.
desc.zh: Claude API 官方 PHP 客户端库。

desc.en: Official Go-based `ant` command-line tool for the Claude Platform: send messages, manage agents, sessions and files, script every endpoint.
desc.zh: 官方 Go 语言编写的 `ant` 命令行工具：在终端发送消息、管理智能体/会话/文件，并脚本化调用所有 API 端点。

desc.en: Official Python SDK for building Model Context Protocol servers and clients, including FastMCP-style server APIs.
desc.zh: 构建 MCP 服务器与客户端的官方 Python SDK，包含 FastMCP 风格的服务器 API。

desc.en: Official TypeScript SDK for building Model Context Protocol servers and clients.
desc.zh: 构建 MCP 服务器与客户端的官方 TypeScript SDK。

desc.en: Official Claude Code docs: install, CLAUDE.md memory, skills, hooks, subagents, MCP, plugins, settings, CI, routines and every surface.
desc.zh: Claude Code 官方文档：安装、CLAUDE.md 记忆、技能、钩子、子代理、MCP、插件、设置、CI、定时任务及各使用端。

desc.en: Anthropic's canonical guide: give Claude verification, explore-plan-code, lean CLAUDE.md, context management, subagents, parallel sessions and fan-out.
desc.zh: Anthropic 权威实践指南：为 Claude 提供验证手段、先探索再计划后编码、精简 CLAUDE.md、管理上下文、子代理与并行会话。

desc.en: Official guide to the Claude Agent SDK: agent loop, tools, hooks, subagents, sessions, permissions, plugins, plus Python and TypeScript references.
desc.zh: Claude Agent SDK 官方指南：智能体循环、工具、钩子、子代理、会话、权限、插件，以及 Python/TypeScript 参考。

desc.en: Official Claude Developer Platform docs: Messages API, models, tool use, prompt caching, structured outputs, Managed Agents, SDKs and release notes.
desc.zh: Claude 开发者平台官方文档：Messages API、模型、工具调用、提示缓存、结构化输出、Managed Agents、SDK 及发布说明。

desc.en: Specification and docs for Agent Skills, the SKILL.md folder format originated by Anthropic and adopted by many agents.
desc.zh: Agent Skills 规范与文档：由 Anthropic 发起、被众多智能体采用的 SKILL.md 文件夹格式开放标准。

desc.en: Anthropic's engineering blog with deep dives on agents, context engineering, tools, skills, harnesses, sandboxing, evals and postmortems.
desc.zh: Anthropic 工程博客，深入探讨智能体、上下文工程、工具、技能、运行框架、沙箱、评测与事故复盘。

desc.en: Anthropic developers' technical blog on building with Claude and Claude Code: tips, playbooks, harness design, effort settings, build logs.
desc.zh: Anthropic 开发者技术博客，分享使用 Claude 与 Claude Code 构建的技巧、实战手册、框架设计与构建日志。

desc.en: Official status page for claude.ai, Claude Console, Claude API, Claude Code and Cowork, with incident history and subscriptions.
desc.zh: 官方服务状态页，覆盖 claude.ai、Console、Claude API、Claude Code 与 Cowork，含故障历史与订阅通知。

desc.en: Official Anthropic/Claude community Discord server for developers and users.
desc.zh: Anthropic/Claude 官方社区 Discord 服务器，面向开发者与用户。

desc.en: Official MCP website with concepts, architecture, server/client building guides, MCP Apps and security best practices.
desc.zh: MCP 官方网站，包含概念、架构、服务器/客户端构建指南、MCP Apps 与安全最佳实践。

desc.en: Materials from Anthropic's Code with Claude workshops: model selection, multi-agent systems with skills and MCP, Managed Agents, memory, evals.
desc.zh: Anthropic “Code with Claude” 工作坊资料：模型选择、基于技能与 MCP 的多智能体、Managed Agents、记忆与评测驱动开发。

desc.en: Jesse Vincent's agentic skills framework and dev methodology: brainstorming, planning, TDD, debugging, subagent-driven development. Ships in the official plugin marketplace.
desc.zh: Jesse Vincent 打造的智能体技能框架与开发方法论，涵盖头脑风暴、规划、TDD、调试和子智能体驱动开发，已上架官方插件市场。

desc.en: Matt Pocock's personal skills for real engineers, including grill-me, tdd, diagnosing-bugs and handoff; among the most-installed skills on skills.sh.
desc.zh: Matt Pocock 分享的个人工程技能集，包括 grill-me、tdd、diagnosing-bugs 和 handoff，是 skills.sh 上安装量最高的技能之一。

desc.en: Addy Osmani's production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents: 24 lifecycle skills plus a using-agent-skills meta-skill.
desc.zh: Addy Osmani 为 AI 编程智能体编写的生产级工程技能集，包含 24 个软件生命周期技能和一个 using-agent-skills 元技能。

desc.en: Vercel's open Agent Skills directory and install leaderboard; browse skills and install them into Claude Code and other agents with npx skills add.
desc.zh: Vercel 推出的开放 Agent Skills 目录和安装量排行榜，可浏览技能并通过 npx skills add 安装到 Claude Code 等智能体。

desc.en: CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem: add, list, find, update and remove skills across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and 75+ agents.
desc.zh: 开放智能体技能生态的命令行工具，可在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等 75 款以上智能体中添加、查找、更新和移除技能。

desc.en: Curated collection of 1,000+ agent skills from official dev teams and the community, compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor.
desc.zh: 精选 1000 多个来自官方团队和社区的智能体技能，兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 和 Cursor。

desc.en: Community skills marketplace indexing millions of open-source agent skills from GitHub, searchable by category or occupation, with REST API and MCP server.
desc.zh: 社区技能市场，索引 GitHub 上数百万开源智能体技能，可按类别或职业搜索，并提供 REST API 和 MCP 服务器。

desc.en: 177+ science skills and access to 100+ scientific databases that turn Claude or any agent into an AI scientist. Formerly Claude Scientific Skills.
desc.zh: 提供 177 个以上科研技能并接入 100 多个科学数据库，把 Claude 或任意智能体变成 AI 科学家。原名 Claude Scientific Skills。

desc.en: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents covering CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics and growth engineering.
desc.zh: 面向 Claude Code 和 AI 智能体的营销技能集，涵盖转化率优化、文案、SEO、数据分析和增长工程。

desc.en: Agent skill that detects and removes telltale signs of AI-generated writing from text.
desc.zh: 识别并去除文本中 AI 生成痕迹的智能体技能。

desc.en: Skills that give coding agents design taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check, steering away from generic AI-looking pages.
desc.zh: 为编程智能体赋予设计品味的技能集：艺术指导、参考图和浏览器检查，避免生成千篇一律的 AI 风格页面。

desc.en: Design-intelligence skill that helps agents build professional UI/UX across multiple platforms and frameworks.
desc.zh: 提供设计智能的技能，帮助智能体在多平台、多框架下构建专业的 UI/UX。

desc.en: Skill plus proxy that makes coding agents talk like a caveman to cut output tokens; author benchmarks about one-third fewer session tokens.
desc.zh: 一个爆红的技能加代理，让编程智能体用“原始人”式简短语言说话以节省输出 token，作者实测整个会话约少用三分之一。

desc.en: YAGNI skill and Claude Code plugin that makes your agent think like the laziest senior dev: write less code, avoid over-engineering.
desc.zh: 遵循 YAGNI 原则的技能兼 Claude Code 插件，让智能体像最“懒”的资深工程师一样少写代码、避免过度设计。

desc.en: Skill that stops coding agents from burying the answer, producing ADHD-friendly, answer-first output; packaged as a Claude Code plugin.
desc.zh: 让编程智能体不再把答案埋在长篇大论里的技能，输出先给结论、对 ADHD 友好，已打包为 Claude Code 插件。

desc.en: Agent skills from Obsidian's CEO teaching agents the Obsidian CLI and open formats: Markdown, Bases and JSON Canvas.
desc.zh: Obsidian CEO 发布的智能体技能，教智能体使用 Obsidian CLI 及 Markdown、Bases、JSON Canvas 等开放格式。

desc.en: Persistent file-based planning skill for long-running agent tasks: plans live on disk to survive context loss, with session recovery and completion checks.
desc.zh: 面向长时间运行智能体任务的文件式持久规划技能：计划保存在磁盘上以应对上下文丢失，支持会话恢复和完成检查。

desc.en: Baoyu's productivity skills for Claude Code and Codex: image generation, WeChat publishing, cover images, infographics, Xiaohongshu cards, slides and comics.
desc.zh: 宝玉分享的效率技能集，适用于 Claude Code 和 Codex：AI 生图、发布公众号、封面图、信息图、小红书卡片、幻灯片和知识漫画。

desc.en: Trail of Bits' Claude Code skills for security research, vulnerability detection and audit workflows.
desc.zh: Trail of Bits 发布的 Claude Code 技能集，用于安全研究、漏洞检测和代码审计工作流。

desc.en: Skill authoring tool that converts documentation websites, GitHub repos and PDFs into Claude skills with automatic conflict detection.
desc.zh: 技能生成工具，可将文档网站、GitHub 仓库和 PDF 转换为 Claude 技能，并自动检测冲突。

desc.en: Anthropic's official meta-skill for creating, editing and evaluating new skills, bundled with scripts, references and an eval viewer.
desc.zh: Anthropic 官方元技能，用于创建、修改和评估新技能，附带脚本、参考资料和评测查看器。

name: Claude Code docs: Extend Claude with skills

desc.en: Official guide to writing SKILL.md skills in Claude Code; custom slash commands are now merged into skills, while .claude/commands still works.
desc.zh: Claude Code 官方技能编写指南；自定义斜杠命令现已并入技能体系，.claude/commands 目录仍可继续使用。

desc.en: Chinese-localized study edition of Anthropic's official skills repo (docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx, frontend design, etc.).
desc.zh: Anthropic 官方 skills 仓库的中文学习版，汉化了 Word/PDF/PPT/Excel 处理、前端设计等官方技能，便于中文用户理解与改造。

desc.en: 161+ specialized Claude Code subagents in 10 categories, installable by category via the plugin marketplace or an interactive script.
desc.zh: 收录 10 大类、161 个以上专业 Claude Code 子智能体，可通过插件市场按类别安装，也可用交互式脚本安装。

desc.en: Multi-harness plugin marketplace with 200+ agents, 185 skills and 105 commands in 94 focused plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more.
desc.zh: 跨平台插件市场，以 94 个细分插件提供 200 多个智能体、185 个技能和 105 个命令，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等。

desc.en: 'complete AI agency' of 230+ specialist agent personas with defined processes and deliverables; native .md files that drop into ~/.claude/agents.
desc.zh: 爆红的“完整 AI 代理公司”项目，包含 230 多个职责、流程和交付物明确的专家智能体角色，原生 .md 文件可直接放入 ~/.claude/agents。

desc.en: 37 studio-style agents across engineering, design, marketing, product, testing and operations departments for rapid app development.
desc.zh: 按工作室部门组织的 37 个智能体，覆盖工程、设计、营销、产品、测试和运营，用于快速开发应用。

desc.en: Orchestrated sub-agent dev team of 24 agents: orchestrators, framework specialists and universal experts that coordinate on features.
desc.zh: 由 24 个子智能体组成的协同开发团队，包括编排者、框架专家和通用专家，分工协作完成功能开发。

desc.en: 33 specialized subagents for full-stack development, including an agent-organizer that dispatches tasks to the right expert.
desc.zh: 面向全栈开发的 33 个专业子智能体，包含可将任务分派给合适专家的 agent-organizer。

desc.en: 100+ production-ready development subagents, mostly per-language and per-framework experts.
desc.zh: 100 多个可用于生产的开发子智能体，多为针对具体语言和框架的专家。

name: A List of Claude Code Agents

desc.en: Community-submitted index of Claude Code sub-agents from the awesome-claude-code maintainer; passively maintained and uncurated.
desc.zh: awesome-claude-code 维护者整理的社区投稿 Claude Code 子智能体索引，被动维护、未经筛选。

desc.en: Configuration framework adding 30 slash commands, 20 agents, cognitive personas and behavioral modes covering the dev lifecycle from brainstorming to deployment.
desc.zh: 为 Claude Code 增加 30 个斜杠命令、20 个智能体、认知角色和行为模式的配置框架，覆盖从头脑风暴到部署的开发全流程。

desc.en: 216+ professional slash commands plus 50+ agents and 12 skills for code review, feature creation, security audits and architecture analysis.
desc.zh: 200 多个专业斜杠命令，另附 50 多个智能体和 12 个技能，用于代码审查、功能开发、安全审计和架构分析。

desc.en: Commands and skills: meta-prompting, todo management, context handoff, /consider thinking models, and creators for skills, subagents and hooks.
desc.zh: 热门命令与技能合集：元提示、待办管理、上下文交接、/consider 思维模型，以及技能、子智能体和钩子的生成器。

desc.en: Slash-command workflows for spec-driven development (Requirements → Design → Tasks → Implementation) and structured bug fixing.
desc.zh: 用于规格驱动开发（需求→设计→任务→实现）和结构化修 bug 的斜杠命令工作流。

desc.en: Kiro-style spec-driven development harness: slash-invoked /kiro-* skills that turn approved specs into long-running autonomous implementation.
desc.zh: Kiro 风格的规格驱动开发工具，通过 /kiro-* 斜杠技能把已批准的规格转化为长时间自主实现。

desc.en: Collection of Claude Code utilities: slash commands, autonomous skills, expert agents and prompts for development workflows.
desc.zh: Claude Code 实用工具合集，包含斜杠命令、自主技能、专家智能体和开发工作流提示词。

desc.en: Official reference for Claude Code built-in slash commands and bundled skills such as /help, /compact and /code-review.
desc.zh: Claude Code 内置斜杠命令及捆绑技能（如 /help、/compact、/code-review）的官方参考。

desc.en: Official hooks reference: 30+ lifecycle events (PreToolUse, Stop, SessionStart, PreCompact...) with command, HTTP, MCP, prompt and agent hook handlers.
desc.zh: 官方钩子参考：30 多个生命周期事件（PreToolUse、Stop、SessionStart、PreCompact 等），支持 command、HTTP、MCP、prompt 和 agent 等处理器。

desc.en: Docs for mods: plugins with in-process JavaScript/TypeScript hooks that can guard tool calls, add instant commands and draw panes in Claude Code's UI.
desc.zh: Mods 文档：Mods 是带有进程内 JavaScript/TypeScript 钩子的插件，可拦截工具调用、添加即时命令，并在 Claude Code 界面中绘制面板。

desc.en: Anthropic's sample mods: token-weather context forecast, blast-radius guard for risky commands, and replay-theater for stepping through last-turn edits.
desc.zh: Anthropic 官方示例 Mods：token-weather 上下文预报、拦截危险命令的 blast-radius，以及逐步回放上一轮编辑的 replay-theater。

desc.en: IndyDevDan's hands-on reference implementing every hook event with uv Python scripts: TTS, logging, security guards, status lines and subagent control.
desc.zh: IndyDevDan 的实战参考项目，用 uv Python 脚本实现所有钩子事件：语音播报、日志、安全防护、状态栏和子智能体控制。

desc.en: Hook collection plus installable plugin marketplace: dangerous-command blocking, secret protection, git safety, instructions audit, cost tracking and session logs.
desc.zh: 钩子合集兼可安装的插件市场：拦截危险命令、保护密钥、Git 安全、指令审计、成本追踪和会话日志。

desc.en: Community catalogue of public Claude Code mods (function hooks), scanned for what each can read, write, run or send over the network.
desc.zh: 公开 Claude Code Mods（函数钩子）的社区目录，逐一扫描每个 Mod 能读取、写入、执行或联网发送的内容。

desc.en: Pre-execution guard hook blocking destructive git and filesystem commands and sensitive-file access before tool calls run; supports many coding CLIs.
desc.zh: 在工具调用执行前拦截破坏性 Git、文件系统命令和敏感文件访问的防护钩子，支持多种编程 CLI。

desc.en: Fast Rust PreToolUse hook that blocks dangerous git and shell commands (rm -rf, hard resets, force pushes) before agents execute them.
desc.zh: 基于 Rust 的高速 PreToolUse 钩子，在智能体执行前拦截 rm -rf、hard reset、强制推送等危险 Git 和 Shell 命令。

desc.en: Hook-based automated TDD enforcement for Claude Code: blocks implementation that skips failing tests or over-implements.
desc.zh: 基于钩子的 Claude Code 自动化 TDD 约束工具，阻止跳过失败测试或过度实现的代码改动。

desc.en: Warcraft III Peon (and 165+ other) voice-line notifications when Claude Code finishes, needs permission or errors; also Codex, Cursor and IDEs.
desc.zh: Claude Code 任务完成、请求权限或出错时，用魔兽争霸 III 苦工等 165 多套游戏语音提醒你，也支持 Codex、Cursor 和各类 IDE。

desc.en: Adds voice/sound feedback to every Claude Code hook event, tracking 30 hooks against recent Claude Code versions.
desc.zh: 为每个 Claude Code 钩子事件添加语音/音效反馈，跟进最新 Claude Code 版本的 30 个钩子。

desc.en: Python SDK for writing Claude Code hooks: parses stdin JSON, supports all event types, simple exit-code or advanced JSON control.
desc.zh: 用于编写 Claude Code 钩子的 Python SDK：解析 stdin JSON，支持全部事件类型，可用简单退出码或高级 JSON 控制。

desc.en: Official plugin that creates custom hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors, from conversation patterns or explicit instructions.
desc.zh: 官方插件，可根据对话模式或明确指令生成自定义钩子，阻止不希望出现的行为。

desc.en: Anthropic's read-only community marketplace mirror for Claude Code and Cowork; plugins submitted via web form and security-scanned before listing.
desc.zh: Anthropic 面向 Claude Code 和 Cowork 的只读社区插件市场镜像，插件经网页表单提交并通过安全扫描后上架。

desc.en: Anthropic's web catalog of 300+ plugins bundling tools, skills and integrations for Claude Code and claude.ai, e.g. Frontend Design, Superpowers, Context7.
desc.zh: Anthropic 的网页插件目录，收录 300 多个集成工具、技能和连接器的插件，适用于 Claude Code 和 claude.ai，如 Frontend Design、Superpowers、Context7。

desc.en: Anthropic's example plugins in the Claude Code repo: code-review, feature-dev, frontend-design, pr-review-toolkit, plugin-dev, security-guidance and more.
desc.zh: Claude Code 仓库中的 Anthropic 示例插件：code-review、feature-dev、frontend-design、pr-review-toolkit、plugin-dev、security-guidance 等。

desc.en: Official plugin for the 'Ralph Wiggum' loop: a Stop hook re-feeds the prompt so Claude iterates on a task until a completion promise.
desc.zh: 实现“Ralph Wiggum”循环的官方插件：通过 Stop 钩子反复投喂同一提示，让 Claude 持续迭代任务直到输出完成标记。

desc.en: Every's official compound engineering plugin: plan, work, review, compound loops where each unit of work makes the next easier.
desc.zh: Every 官方的复利工程插件：以“规划—执行—评审—沉淀”循环让每次工作都让下一次更轻松。

desc.en: Claude Code plugin using a multi-agent pipeline to turn codebases or docs into interactive, queryable knowledge graphs.
desc.zh: Claude Code 插件，借助多智能体流水线把代码库或文档转化为可交互、可查询的知识图谱。

desc.en: Curated list of Claude Code plugins that add custom commands, agents, hooks and MCP servers through the plugin system.
desc.zh: 精选 Claude Code 插件清单，收录通过插件系统添加自定义命令、智能体、钩子和 MCP 服务器的插件。

desc.en: Lightweight registry and CLI to discover, install and manage public Claude plugins and agent skills; browse at claude-plugins.dev.
desc.zh: 轻量级注册表与 CLI，用于发现、安装和管理公开的 Claude 插件与智能体技能，可在 claude-plugins.dev 浏览。

name: Claude Code Plugins Plus Skills (Tons of Skills)

desc.en: Large marketplace of 400+ plugins and ~2,900 skills with the ccpi package manager; browsable at tonsofskills.com.
desc.zh: 大型插件市场，提供 400 多个插件和约 2900 个技能，配套 ccpi 包管理器，可在 tonsofskills.com 浏览。

desc.en: Independent directory of 2,700+ Claude Code plugin marketplaces, plus indexed skills and MCP servers.
desc.zh: 独立的 Claude Code 插件市场目录，收录 2700 多个插件市场，并索引技能和 MCP 服务器。

desc.en: Hub and marketplace for Claude skills, agents, commands, hooks and plugins, with a discovery site at buildwithclaude.com.
desc.zh: Claude 技能、智能体、命令、钩子和插件的聚合中心兼插件市场，配套 buildwithclaude.com 发现站点。

desc.en: CLI and aitmpl.com catalog to install agents, commands, settings, hooks, MCPs and skills, plus analytics, chat monitor and health check.
desc.zh: 命令行工具及 aitmpl.com 模板目录，可一键安装智能体、命令、设置、钩子、MCP 和技能，并提供数据分析、会话监控和健康检查。

desc.en: Massive harness config system: 71 agents, 300+ skills, hooks, rules, memory and AgentShield security scanning for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more.
desc.zh: 超大型智能体配置体系：71 个智能体、300 多个技能、钩子、规则、记忆以及 AgentShield 安全扫描，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等。

desc.en: Reference examples of a real Claude Code infrastructure: skill auto-activation via hooks, specialized agents and supporting configuration.
desc.zh: 真实 Claude Code 基础设施的参考示例：通过钩子自动激活技能、专业智能体及配套配置。

desc.en: Comprehensive example project configuration with hooks, skills, agents, commands and GitHub Actions workflows.
desc.zh: 完整的项目配置示例，涵盖钩子、技能、智能体、命令和 GitHub Actions 工作流。

desc.en: Shared starter template configuration and CLAUDE.md memory-bank system, regularly updated with new templates.
desc.zh: 共享的入门模板配置与 CLAUDE.md 记忆库体系，持续更新新模板。

name: Trail of Bits Claude Code Config

desc.en: Trail of Bits' opinionated security-minded defaults, documentation and workflows for Claude Code.
desc.zh: Trail of Bits 出品的注重安全的 Claude Code 默认配置、文档和工作流。

desc.en: Curated settings, skills, sub-agents and config templates for Claude Code: research, image generation, GitHub automation and more.
desc.zh: 精选的 Claude Code 设置、技能、子智能体和配置模板，涵盖研究、图像生成、GitHub 自动化等。

desc.en: Structured workflow kit for beginner and intermediate users: tiered documentation, CLAUDE.md context, hooks and commands, with tutorial and installer.
desc.zh: 面向初中级用户的结构化工作流套件：分层文档体系、CLAUDE.md 上下文、钩子和命令，附教程与安装器。

desc.en: Curated collection of exemplary CLAUDE.md files from public GitHub projects, with analyses, best practices and templates.
desc.zh: 精选公开 GitHub 项目中优秀的 CLAUDE.md 文件，附分析、最佳实践和模板。

desc.en: AGENTS.md rules and skills distilled from classic engineering books (clean code, refactoring, DDD, clean architecture) for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
desc.zh: 从经典工程书籍（整洁代码、重构、DDD、整洁架构等）提炼的 AGENTS.md 规则与技能，适用于 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor。

desc.en: Official guide to output styles: markdown files that change how Claude responds, with built-in styles and custom styles in .claude/output-styles.
desc.zh: 官方输出风格指南：通过 Markdown 文件改变 Claude 的回复方式，包含内置风格和放在 .claude/output-styles 中的自定义风格。

desc.en: Open 'README for agents' instruction-file format stewarded by the Agentic AI Foundation; Claude Code can load AGENTS.md as project instructions.
desc.zh: 由 Agentic AI Foundation 托管的开放“智能体 README”指令文件格式；Claude Code 可将 AGENTS.md 作为项目指令加载。

desc.en: GitHub's open-source spec-driven development toolkit: constitution, specify, plan, tasks and implement commands that work with Claude Code and other agents.
desc.zh: GitHub 官方开源的规格驱动开发（SDD）工具包，提供 constitution、specify、plan、tasks、implement 等命令，适用于 Claude Code 及其他代理。

desc.en: Breakthrough Method for Agile AI-Driven Development: role-based agents (analyst, PM, architect, dev, QA) producing planning docs and stories across the SDLC.
desc.zh: 敏捷 AI 驱动开发方法论：由分析师、产品经理、架构师、开发、QA 等角色代理贯穿软件生命周期，产出规划文档与用户故事。

desc.en: Lightweight meta-prompting, context-engineering and spec-driven development system guiding agents through a repeatable phase loop; continuation of get-shit-done.
desc.zh: 轻量级元提示、上下文工程与规格驱动开发系统，引导代理按可重复的阶段循环工作；get-shit-done 的延续项目。

desc.en: Lightweight spec-driven development for AI coding assistants built around proposing, reviewing and archiving change deltas; strong fit for brownfield codebases.
desc.zh: 面向 AI 编程助手的轻量级规格驱动开发，以变更提案的提出、评审与归档为核心，尤其适合存量项目。

desc.en: AI-powered task management that parses PRDs into dependency-aware tasks, usable via MCP or CLI in Claude Code, Cursor and other editors.
desc.zh: AI 任务管理系统，把 PRD 拆解为带依赖关系的任务，可通过 MCP 或 CLI 在 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具中使用。

desc.en: Project management system for Claude Code using GitHub Issues and git worktrees: PRDs become epics and tasks executed by parallel agents.
desc.zh: 基于 GitHub Issues 与 git worktree 的 Claude Code 项目管理系统：PRD 转化为史诗与任务，由并行代理执行。

desc.en: Builder Methods' system for injecting codebase standards into agents and writing better specs for spec-driven development.
desc.zh: Builder Methods 推出的系统，为代理注入代码库规范，并帮助编写更好的规格以进行规格驱动开发。

desc.en: MCP server providing structured spec-driven workflow tools, with a real-time web dashboard and VS Code extension for tracking progress.
desc.zh: 提供结构化规格驱动工作流工具的 MCP 服务器，附带实时 Web 仪表盘和 VS Code 扩展用于跟踪进度。

desc.en: Prompts, commands and workflows for agentic engineering built on Product Requirement Prompts: context-rich specs that let Claude Code ship in one pass.
desc.zh: 基于产品需求提示（PRP）的代理式工程提示、命令与工作流：用富上下文规格让 Claude Code 一次成型交付。

desc.en: Simple markdown prompt set guiding agents from PRD creation to task lists to step-by-step, reviewable implementation.
desc.zh: 简洁的 Markdown 提示集，引导代理从编写 PRD 到生成任务清单，再到逐步、可审查的实现。

desc.en: Workflow engine defining plan, implement, validate and PR steps in YAML so Claude Code, Codex or Pi runs are deterministic and repeatable.
desc.zh: 工作流引擎，用 YAML 定义计划、实现、验证、提交 PR 等步骤，让 Claude Code、Codex 或 Pi 的运行确定且可重复。

desc.en: Plan-work-review development harness for Claude Code that keeps specs in spec.md and tasks in Plans.md, driven by verb-based skills.
desc.zh: 面向 Claude Code 的计划—执行—评审开发框架，规格存于 spec.md、任务存于 Plans.md，由动词式技能驱动。

desc.en: Claude Code meta-skill plugin that turns a plain-language request into a domain-specific agent team plus the skills and orchestration they need.
desc.zh: Claude Code 元技能插件，把自然语言需求转化为特定领域的代理团队及其所需的技能与编排。

desc.en: Spec-first 'Agent OS' plugin running an interview, spec, execute, evaluate and evolve loop with staged evaluation, served over MCP.
desc.zh: 规格优先的“代理操作系统”插件，执行访谈、规格、执行、评估、演进循环，带分阶段评估，通过 MCP 提供服务。

name: Advanced Context Engineering for Coding Agents

desc.en: HumanLayer's write-ups and benchmarks on context engineering for coding agents, covering research-plan-implement workflows for large codebases.
desc.zh: HumanLayer 关于编程代理上下文工程的文章与基准测试，涵盖面向大型代码库的“调研—计划—实现”工作流。

desc.en: Visual tool to annotate and review agent plans and code diffs, sharing them with teammates and sending feedback back to the agent in one click.
desc.zh: 可视化工具，用于批注和审阅代理的计划与代码差异，可与团队共享，并一键把反馈发回代理。

desc.en: Team-oriented agent harness that splits giant CLAUDE.md into progressive specs, tasks, workflows and memory, injected via hooks for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex.
desc.zh: 面向团队的 AI 编码框架，把臃肿的 CLAUDE.md 拆成渐进加载的规范、任务、工作流与记忆，通过 hooks 自动注入，支持 Claude Code/Cursor/Codex，有中文文档。

desc.en: Classmethod's AI-driven development framework, installed as a Claude Code plugin, from requirements through implementation.
desc.zh: Classmethod 推出的 AI 驱动开发框架，以 Claude Code 插件形式安装，覆盖从需求定义到实现。

desc.en: Collection of Claude Code commands, roles and hooks settings, with docs in Japanese, English and six other languages.
desc.zh: Claude Code 命令、角色和 hooks 配置合集，文档提供日文、英文等八种语言。

desc.en: Terminal app managing multiple Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Amp sessions in tmux, each isolated in its own git worktree.
desc.zh: 终端应用，在 tmux 中管理多个 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 或 Amp 会话，每个会话隔离在独立的 git worktree 中。

desc.en: MIT-licensed desktop orchestrator with mobile companion for running fleets of Claude Code, Codex and other CLI agents side by side in worktrees.
desc.zh: MIT 许可的桌面编排器（附移动端），可在 git worktree 中并排运行大量 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 代理。

desc.en: Agent harness for deploying multi-agent swarms and autonomous workflows, with adaptive memory, federation and vector RAG; originally built around Claude Code.
desc.zh: 用于部署多代理集群与自主工作流的代理框架，具备自适应记忆、联邦与向量 RAG；最初围绕 Claude Code 构建。

desc.en: Steve Yegge's multi-agent workspace manager coordinating many Claude Code agents with git-backed work state, agent mail and a merge queue.
desc.zh: Steve Yegge 打造的多代理工作区管理器，用 git 持久化工作状态，通过代理邮件和合并队列协调大量 Claude Code 代理。

desc.en: Mac app from Melty Labs for running several Claude Code, Codex and Cursor agents at once in isolated workspaces, with review and merge.
desc.zh: Melty Labs 出品的 Mac 应用，可在隔离工作区中同时运行多个 Claude Code、Codex 与 Cursor 代理，并审阅、合并其成果。

desc.en: Agentic IDE and terminal for orchestrating many Claude Code and Codex agents in parallel across git worktrees.
desc.zh: 代理式 IDE 与终端，可跨 git worktree 并行编排大量 Claude Code 与 Codex 代理。

desc.en: Open-source agentic development environment from a YC W26 team, running multiple coding agents in parallel across providers.
desc.zh: 来自 YC W26 团队的开源代理式开发环境，可跨提供商并行运行多个编程代理。

desc.en: Open-source visual workspace for running Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode in parallel worktrees, with kanban, visual editing and an iOS companion.
desc.zh: 开源可视化工作区，可在并行 worktree 中运行 Claude Code、Codex 与 OpenCode，提供看板、可视化编辑和 iOS 配套应用。

desc.en: Kanban board for planning, running and reviewing Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents, each working in an isolated worktree.
desc.zh: 看板工具，用于规划、运行和审阅 Claude Code、Codex 等编程代理，每个代理在独立 worktree 中工作。

desc.en: Session manager for running and switching between multiple Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Codex CLI sessions across git worktrees.
desc.zh: 会话管理器，可在多个 git worktree 间运行并切换 Claude Code、Gemini CLI 与 Codex CLI 会话。

desc.en: Apache-2.0 agentic development environment for running multiple coding agents, including Claude Code, in worktrees from desktop, mobile, web or CLI.
desc.zh: Apache-2.0 许可的代理式开发环境，可在桌面、移动端、Web 或 CLI 上于 worktree 中运行包括 Claude Code 在内的多个代理。

desc.en: Rust terminal runtime that keeps coding-agent sessions alive in the background, flags panes as working, blocked or idle, and lets agents control each other.
desc.zh: Rust 编写的终端运行时，让编程代理会话在后台持续运行，标记各窗格为工作、阻塞或空闲，并允许代理互相控制。

desc.en: Teams-first multi-agent orchestration layer for Claude Code with Team, Autopilot, Execute and Verify modes plus tmux workers for other CLIs.
desc.zh: 以团队为先的 Claude Code 多代理编排层，提供 Team、Autopilot、Execute、Verify 等模式，并可用 tmux 调度其他 CLI。

desc.en: Self-hosted platform that orchestrates Claude Code and other agents into a 'company' with org charts, ticket tracking, budgets and governance.
desc.zh: 自托管平台，把 Claude Code 等代理编排成一家“公司”，提供组织架构、工单跟踪、预算与治理。

desc.en: Self-hostable workspace where you assign issues to coding agents such as Claude Code, which report progress and blockers like teammates.
desc.zh: 可自托管的工作区，把 issue 分配给 Claude Code 等编程代理，它们会像同事一样汇报进度与阻塞。

desc.en: Runs and supervises teams of coding agents, including Claude Code, from planning through merge across many harnesses and platforms.
desc.zh: 运行并监督编程代理团队（含 Claude Code），覆盖从规划到合并的全过程，支持多种代理框架与平台。

desc.en: Rust CLI for git worktree management designed for parallel AI agent workflows.
desc.zh: Rust 编写的 git worktree 管理 CLI，专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计。

desc.en: Autonomous multi-session coding desktop app running up to 12 agent terminals with planning and a QA loop.
desc.zh: 自主多会话编程桌面应用，可同时运行最多 12 个代理终端，并带有规划与 QA 循环。

desc.en: Autonomous AI agent loop that runs a coding agent repeatedly with fresh context until every PRD item is complete.
desc.zh: 自主 AI 代理循环，以全新上下文反复运行编程代理，直到 PRD 中的所有条目完成。

desc.en: Autonomous development loop for Claude Code with intelligent exit detection and safeguards against runaway iterations.
desc.zh: 面向 Claude Code 的自主开发循环，具备智能退出检测和防止失控迭代的保护机制。

desc.en: Bridges local Claude Code and other coding agents to Feishu, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, WeCom, LINE, QQ and other chat platforms.
desc.zh: 将本地 Claude Code 等编程代理接入飞书、钉钉、Slack、Telegram、Discord、企业微信、LINE、QQ 等聊天平台的桥接工具。

desc.en: Telegram bot giving remote access to Claude Code with session persistence, so you can work on projects from any device.
desc.zh: Telegram 机器人，提供带会话持久化的 Claude Code 远程访问，可在任意设备上处理项目。

desc.en: Asynchronous coordination layer for coding agents with identities, inboxes, threads and advisory file leases, exposed over MCP.
desc.zh: 编程代理的异步协作层，提供身份、收件箱、线程与建议性文件租约，通过 MCP 暴露。

desc.en: AWS Labs tool coordinating multiple coding CLIs such as Claude Code, Kiro and Codex as supervisor and workers in isolated tmux sessions.
desc.zh: AWS Labs 工具，以主管与工作者模式在隔离的 tmux 会话中协调 Claude Code、Kiro、Codex 等多个编程 CLI。

desc.en: Open-source background coding agent system: triggered agent sessions run in sandboxes and open attributed pull requests.
desc.zh: 开源后台编程代理系统：被触发的代理会话在沙箱中运行，并提交带署名的 Pull Request。

desc.en: Multi-model workflow engine: Claude Code orchestrates Codex and Gemini (and others) via a single /ccg:go command, with zero-write safety for external models.
desc.zh: 多模型协作工作流：以 Claude Code 为总指挥，编排 Codex、Gemini 等协同开发，一条 /ccg:go 命令自动分析意图与执行，外部模型只返回补丁。

desc.en: Persistent memory plugin that captures Claude Code session activity via hooks, compresses it with AI and injects relevant context into future sessions.
desc.zh: 持久记忆插件，通过钩子捕获 Claude Code 会话活动，用 AI 压缩后在后续会话中注入相关上下文。

desc.en: MCP toolkit giving coding agents IDE-like semantic code retrieval and symbol-level editing via language servers; a popular Claude Code companion.
desc.zh: MCP 工具包，借助语言服务器为编程代理提供类 IDE 的语义代码检索与符号级编辑，是 Claude Code 的热门搭档。

desc.en: Steve Yegge's git-backed issue tracker that gives coding agents durable memory of work items, dependencies and progress.
desc.zh: Steve Yegge 开发的基于 git 的问题跟踪器，为编程代理提供工作项、依赖与进度的持久记忆。

desc.en: Turns code, docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph; installs a /graphify skill for Claude Code.
desc.zh: 把代码、文档、SQL 模式、配置与 PDF 转为可查询的知识图谱，并为 Claude Code 安装 /graphify 技能。

desc.en: Code intelligence MCP server that indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph for fast, token-efficient structural queries.
desc.zh: 代码智能 MCP 服务器，把代码库索引为持久知识图谱，支持快速且节省 token 的结构化查询。

desc.en: Local code-intelligence graph for MCP and CLI that helps AI tools read only the code that matters, cutting token use.
desc.zh: 本地代码智能图谱，支持 MCP 与 CLI，让 AI 工具只读取相关代码，从而减少 token 消耗。

desc.en: Claude Code plugin and MCP server that keeps bulky tool output out of context, persists session state in SQLite and restores it after compaction.
desc.zh: Claude Code 插件与 MCP 服务器，把庞大的工具输出挡在上下文之外，用 SQLite 持久化会话状态并在压缩后恢复。

desc.en: Zilliz's semantic code-search MCP server that indexes an entire codebase into a vector database as context for coding agents.
desc.zh: Zilliz 推出的语义代码搜索 MCP 服务器，把整个代码库索引进向量数据库，作为编程代理的上下文。

desc.en: Packs an entire repository into a single AI-friendly file for feeding to LLMs, available as a CLI and MCP server.
desc.zh: 把整个仓库打包成单个 AI 友好的文件供大模型读取，可作为 CLI 或 MCP 服务器使用。

desc.en: Compression layer that shrinks tool outputs, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach the model, reducing token use for coding agents.
desc.zh: 压缩层，在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 片段送达模型前进行压缩，降低编程代理的 token 消耗。

desc.en: Self-learning context layer pairing a tree-sitter code graph with saved team learnings, injected into Claude Code via hooks and an MCP server.
desc.zh: 自学习上下文层，将 tree-sitter 代码图谱与团队保存的经验结合，通过钩子和 MCP 服务器注入 Claude Code。

desc.en: Agent-agnostic persistent memory system shipped as a single Go binary with SQLite storage and an MCP interface.
desc.zh: 与代理无关的持久记忆系统，以单个 Go 二进制文件发布，使用 SQLite 存储并提供 MCP 接口。

desc.en: Obsidian plus Claude Code 'second brain' that files sources into a self-organizing, linked markdown knowledge graph.
desc.zh: Obsidian 与 Claude Code 组合的“第二大脑”，把资料归档为自组织、相互链接的 Markdown 知识图谱。

desc.en: Plugin that lets Claude Code learn in real time and recall knowledge across sessions using Supermemory.
desc.zh: 让 Claude Code 实时学习并借助 Supermemory 跨会话调用知识的插件。

desc.en: Self-learning system that captures your corrections during sessions and syncs them into CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md.
desc.zh: 自学习系统，捕获你在会话中的纠正，并同步写入 CLAUDE.md 与 AGENTS.md。

desc.en: Context management for Claude Code using hooks, ledgers, handoffs and isolated agents to preserve state across compactions and sessions.
desc.zh: Claude Code 上下文管理方案，借助钩子、账本、交接文档与隔离代理，在上下文压缩和会话之间保留状态。

desc.en: Applies one source of rules to all coding agents, generating and syncing CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and other agent instruction files.
desc.zh: 用同一份规则源统一管理所有编程代理，自动生成并同步 CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md 等代理指令文件。

desc.en: CLI that generates and syncs rules and configuration files for Claude Code and other AI coding agents from a single source.
desc.zh: CLI 工具，从单一来源为 Claude Code 及其他 AI 编程代理生成并同步规则与配置文件。

desc.en: Self-learning skill layer for Claude Code: hooks capture sessions and a background reflector distills, updates and prunes skills in .claude/skills.
desc.zh: Claude Code 自学习技能层：钩子记录会话，后台反思器提炼、更新并清理 .claude/skills 中的技能。

desc.en: Zero-install CLI (npx ccusage) that analyzes local Claude Code JSONL logs for daily, monthly, session and 5-hour-block token usage and cost.
desc.zh: 免安装 CLI（npx ccusage），分析本地 Claude Code JSONL 日志，按日、月、会话和 5 小时窗口统计 token 用量与费用。

desc.en: Real-time terminal monitor for Claude Code usage with burn-rate predictions, plan-limit warnings and session reset tracking.
desc.zh: 实时终端监控 Claude Code 用量，提供消耗速率预测、套餐额度预警和会话重置跟踪。

desc.en: macOS menu bar app by Peter Steinberger showing usage stats and limits for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex without logging in.
desc.zh: Peter Steinberger 开发的 macOS 菜单栏应用，无需登录即可显示 Claude Code 和 OpenAI Codex 的用量统计与额度。

desc.en: macOS menu bar app showing remaining quotas for Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot and other AI coding assistants, with burn-rate indicators.
desc.zh: macOS 菜单栏应用，显示 Claude、Codex、Gemini、Copilot 等 AI 编程助手的剩余额度，并提供消耗速率指示。

desc.en: Native Swift/SwiftUI macOS menu bar app that tracks Claude session and weekly usage limits in real time.
desc.zh: 基于 Swift/SwiftUI 的原生 macOS 菜单栏应用，实时追踪 Claude 会话与每周用量额度。

desc.en: Free local tool tracking token usage and cost across 37 AI coding tools, broken down by project, model and task, flagging token waste.
desc.zh: 免费本地工具，追踪 37 种 AI 编程工具的 token 用量和费用，按项目、模型和任务细分，并找出 token 浪费。

desc.en: Terminal tool that tracks token usage across AI coding agents including Claude Code, with an optional global usage leaderboard.
desc.zh: 终端工具，追踪 Claude Code 等 AI 编程智能体的 token 用量，并提供可选的全球用量排行榜。

desc.en: Claude Code dashboard by Chip Huyen showing usage stats, error analysis and shareable reports built from local logs.
desc.zh: Chip Huyen 开发的 Claude Code 仪表盘，基于本地日志展示用量统计、错误分析和可分享的报告。

desc.en: Local dashboard tracking Claude Code token usage, costs and session history, aimed at Pro and Max subscribers.
desc.zh: 本地仪表盘，追踪 Claude Code 的 token 用量、费用和会话历史，面向 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户。

desc.en: ESP32-powered hardware display that shows your Claude Code usage on a small desk screen.
desc.zh: 基于 ESP32 的硬件显示屏，在桌面小屏幕上实时显示你的 Claude Code 用量。

desc.en: Highly customizable Claude Code statusline with interactive TUI configurator, powerline themes and widgets for model, git, tokens, context and usage.
desc.zh: 高度可定制的 Claude Code 状态栏，带交互式 TUI 配置器、powerline 主题，以及模型、git、token、上下文和用量等组件。

desc.en: Claude Code plugin that turns the statusline into a HUD showing context usage, active tools, running subagents and todo progress.
desc.zh: Claude Code 插件，把状态栏变成 HUD，显示上下文占用、正在使用的工具、运行中的子代理和待办进度。

desc.en: High-performance Rust statusline for Claude Code with git, model and context segments, TUI theme configuration and Claude Code enhancement utilities.
desc.zh: 用 Rust 编写的高性能 Claude Code 状态栏，包含 git、模型和上下文等分段，支持 TUI 主题配置和 Claude Code 增强工具。

desc.en: Vim-style powerline statusline for Claude Code with real-time usage and cost tracking, git integration and custom themes.
desc.zh: Vim 风格的 Claude Code powerline 状态栏，支持实时用量与费用追踪、git 集成和自定义主题。

desc.en: Interactive setup tool that generates and installs an informative Claude Code statusline script showing model, directory, git, context and cost.
desc.zh: 交互式配置工具，生成并安装信息丰富的 Claude Code 状态栏脚本，显示模型、目录、git、上下文和费用。

desc.en: Lightweight statusline showing 5-hour and 7-day rate-limit usage with reset countdowns, context window, prompt-cache expiry and session cost.
desc.zh: 轻量级状态栏，显示 5 小时和 7 天限额用量及重置倒计时、上下文窗口、提示缓存过期时间和会话费用。

desc.en: Feature-rich Claude Code statusline with flexible multi-line layouts, real-time cost tracking, MCP status and configurable themes.
desc.zh: 功能丰富的 Claude Code 状态栏，支持灵活的多行布局、实时费用追踪、MCP 状态和可配置主题。

desc.en: Official guide to configuring Claude Code's custom status line via settings.json and scripts that receive session JSON on stdin.
desc.zh: 官方指南：通过 settings.json 和从 stdin 接收会话 JSON 的脚本来配置 Claude Code 自定义状态栏。

desc.en: Desktop GUI and toolkit for Claude Code (formerly Claudia): manage sessions, create custom agents, track usage and configure MCP servers.
desc.zh: Claude Code 桌面 GUI 与工具集（前身为 Claudia）：管理会话、创建自定义代理、追踪用量并配置 MCP 服务器。

desc.en: Web and mobile PWA for driving Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI and OpenCode remotely, with file explorer, git, shell and session management.
desc.zh: Web 与移动端 PWA，可远程驱动 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor CLI 和 OpenCode，内置文件浏览、git、终端和会话管理。

desc.en: Open-source mobile and desktop client to run and control Claude Code and Codex sessions remotely, with end-to-end encryption, push notifications and voice.
desc.zh: 开源移动端与桌面客户端，可远程运行和控制 Claude Code 与 Codex 会话，支持端到端加密、推送通知和语音。

desc.en: Open-source Ghostty-based macOS terminal with vertical tabs and notifications, built for running AI coding agents like Claude Code.
desc.zh: 基于 Ghostty 的开源 macOS 终端，带垂直标签页和通知，专为运行 Claude Code 等 AI 编程代理而设计。

desc.en: Open-source cross-platform cowork desktop app that provides a GUI for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ other CLI agents.
desc.zh: 开源跨平台协作桌面应用，为 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 及 20 多种 CLI 代理提供图形界面。

desc.en: Turns any browser into your terminal so you can monitor and command Claude Code and other agents from anywhere, including your phone.
desc.zh: 把任意浏览器变成你的终端，随时随地（包括手机上）监控和操控 Claude Code 等代理。

desc.en: macOS notch app showing Dynamic Island-style Claude Code session status and letting you approve or deny tool permissions from an overlay.
desc.zh: macOS 刘海应用，以灵动岛风格显示 Claude Code 会话状态，并可在浮层中批准或拒绝工具权限请求。

desc.en: Open-source, Lovable-style web app builder that uses local CLI agents like Claude Code and Codex to generate and preview apps.
desc.zh: 开源的类 Lovable 网页应用构建器，借助 Claude Code、Codex 等本地 CLI 代理生成并预览应用。

desc.en: Multi-model AI agent desktop client (Electron + Next.js) with MCP and skills support and phone remote control, by AI blogger Guizang.
desc.zh: AI 博主歸藏（op7418）开发的多模型 Agent 桌面客户端，支持 MCP 与 Skills，可用手机远程控制，基于 Electron + Next.js。

desc.en: Full-featured web client for browsing and interacting with Claude Code projects and sessions.
desc.zh: 功能完整的 Web 客户端，用于浏览和操作 Claude Code 项目与会话。

desc.en: Pure-Lua Neovim plugin implementing Claude Code's IDE protocol, giving Neovim the same diff, selection and context integration as the VS Code extension.
desc.zh: 纯 Lua 实现的 Neovim 插件，实现 Claude Code 的 IDE 协议，让 Neovim 获得与 VS Code 扩展相同的差异、选区和上下文集成。

desc.en: Neovim plugin that runs Claude Code in a terminal buffer with quick toggles, automatic file reload on changes and git-root awareness.
desc.zh: Neovim 插件，在终端缓冲区中运行 Claude Code，支持快速切换、文件变更自动重载和 git 根目录识别。

desc.en: Emacs IDE integration for Claude Code over MCP, exposing diagnostics, ediff-based diff review and project context to Claude.
desc.zh: 基于 MCP 的 Emacs 版 Claude Code IDE 集成，向 Claude 提供诊断信息、基于 ediff 的差异审阅和项目上下文。

desc.en: Emacs integration that runs Claude Code in a terminal buffer (eat or vterm) with commands for sending regions, files and errors.
desc.zh: Emacs 集成，在终端缓冲区（eat 或 vterm）中运行 Claude Code，并提供发送选区、文件和错误信息的命令。

desc.en: Native Emacs buffer interface for ACP agents including Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI, with familiar bindings and no terminal emulation.
desc.zh: 原生 Emacs 缓冲区界面，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 ACP 代理，沿用熟悉的快捷键且无需终端模拟。

desc.en: Agent Client Protocol adapter that runs Claude Code via the Claude Agent SDK inside Zed and other ACP-compatible editors.
desc.zh: Agent Client Protocol（ACP）适配器，基于 Claude Agent SDK 让 Claude Code 在 Zed 及其他兼容 ACP 的编辑器中运行。

desc.en: Anthropic's official VS Code extension with a native Claude Code panel, inline diffs, plan review and @-mentions; also installable in VS Code forks.
desc.zh: Anthropic 官方 VS Code 扩展，提供原生 Claude Code 面板、内联差异、计划审阅和 @ 引用，也可安装在 VS Code 衍生编辑器中。

desc.en: Official Claude Code plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand and other JetBrains IDEs, with IDE diff viewing and selection context sharing.
desc.zh: 官方 Claude Code 插件，支持 IntelliJ IDEA、PyCharm、WebStorm、GoLand 等 JetBrains IDE，可在 IDE 中查看差异并共享选区上下文。

desc.en: Community JetBrains IDE plugin that provides a graphical chat interface for Claude Code and Codex instead of the terminal.
desc.zh: 社区开发的 JetBrains IDE 插件，为 Claude Code 和 Codex 提供图形化聊天界面，替代终端操作。

desc.en: VS Code extension providing a polished chat interface for Claude Code, with conversation history, checkpoints and MCP server management.
desc.zh: VS Code 扩展，为 Claude Code 提供精致的聊天界面，支持对话历史、检查点和 MCP 服务器管理。

desc.en: Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code (and Codex) as an AI collaborator inside your vault, able to read and edit notes.
desc.zh: Obsidian 插件，将 Claude Code（以及 Codex）作为 AI 协作者嵌入你的知识库，可读取并编辑笔记。

desc.en: Anthropic announcement: Xcode 26.3 natively integrates the Claude Agent SDK, bringing Claude Code-style agentic coding to Xcode and exposing Xcode via MCP.
desc.zh: Anthropic 公告：Xcode 26.3 原生集成 Claude Agent SDK，将 Claude Code 式的智能体编程带入 Xcode，并通过 MCP 开放 Xcode 能力。

desc.en: Routes Claude Code requests to other models and providers (DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, etc.) with per-task routing rules and request transformers.
desc.zh: 将 Claude Code 请求路由到其他模型和服务商（DeepSeek、Gemini、OpenRouter、Ollama 等），支持按任务路由规则和请求转换器。

desc.en: Cross-platform desktop app for switching API providers and managing configs, MCP servers and skills for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other CLI agents.
desc.zh: 跨平台桌面应用，为 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等 CLI 代理一键切换 API 服务商，并管理配置、MCP 服务器和技能。

desc.en: Proxy that lets Claude Code run on OpenAI or Gemini models by translating Anthropic API requests through LiteLLM.
desc.zh: 代理工具，通过 LiteLLM 转换 Anthropic API 请求，让 Claude Code 使用 OpenAI 或 Gemini 模型运行。

desc.en: Proxy that converts Claude Code's Anthropic API calls to any OpenAI-compatible API, with configurable big and small model mapping.
desc.zh: 代理工具，将 Claude Code 的 Anthropic API 调用转换为任意 OpenAI 兼容 API，并可配置大小模型映射。

desc.en: Zero-config CLI that sets up Claude Code and Codex in one command, including API providers, workflows, output styles, MCP services and statusline.
desc.zh: 零配置 CLI，一条命令完成 Claude Code 与 Codex 的初始化，包括 API 服务商、工作流、输出风格、MCP 服务和状态栏。

desc.en: LiteLLM-based proxy for building Claude Code mods: hook any request, modify responses and route /model to custom models.
desc.zh: 基于 LiteLLM 的代理，用于构建 Claude Code 扩展：拦截任意请求、修改响应，并把 /model 路由到自定义模型。

desc.en: Runs Claude Code fully on-device on Apple Silicon via an MLX-native Anthropic-API server serving local Qwen, Gemma and Llama models.
desc.zh: 通过 MLX 原生的 Anthropic API 兼容服务器，在 Apple Silicon 上完全本地运行 Claude Code，使用本地 Qwen、Gemma 和 Llama 模型。

desc.en: Official guide to running Claude Code through LLM gateways such as LiteLLM for centralized authentication, usage tracking, cost control and routing.
desc.zh: 官方指南：通过 LiteLLM 等 LLM 网关运行 Claude Code，实现统一认证、用量追踪、成本控制和路由。

desc.en: LiteLLM tutorial for using Claude Code through the LiteLLM proxy, including routing to non-Anthropic models and tracking spend.
desc.zh: LiteLLM 教程：通过 LiteLLM 代理使用 Claude Code，包括路由到非 Anthropic 模型以及追踪花费。

desc.en: OpenRouter guide to pointing Claude Code at OpenRouter via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL for access to many models with provider failover.
desc.zh: OpenRouter 指南：通过 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 将 Claude Code 接入 OpenRouter，以使用多种模型并获得服务商故障切换。

desc.en: Ollama documentation for running Claude Code against local or Ollama cloud models through Ollama's Anthropic-compatible API.
desc.zh: Ollama 文档：通过 Ollama 的 Anthropic 兼容 API，让 Claude Code 使用本地模型或 Ollama 云端模型。

name: Z.ai GLM Coding Plan for Claude Code

desc.en: Z.ai guide to using GLM models in Claude Code through its Anthropic-compatible endpoint and the GLM Coding Plan.
desc.zh: Z.ai（智谱）指南：通过其 Anthropic 兼容端点和 GLM Coding Plan 在 Claude Code 中使用 GLM 模型。

desc.en: Dagger's tool that gives each coding agent its own containerized environment and git branch, so multiple agents can work safely in parallel.
desc.zh: Dagger 推出的工具，为每个编程代理提供独立的容器环境和 git 分支，让多个代理安全地并行工作。

desc.en: Docker's microVM-based sandboxes for running coding agents like Claude Code autonomously with isolated filesystems and network policies.
desc.zh: Docker 推出的基于微虚拟机的沙箱，可在隔离的文件系统和网络策略下自主运行 Claude Code 等编程代理。

desc.en: Official reference devcontainer with an allowlisting firewall for running Claude Code in isolation, including unattended --dangerously-skip-permissions use.
desc.zh: 官方参考 devcontainer，带白名单防火墙，用于隔离运行 Claude Code，包括无人值守的 --dangerously-skip-permissions 模式。

desc.en: Docker-based Claude Code development environment with per-project isolation, prebuilt language profiles and network firewall controls.
desc.zh: 基于 Docker 的 Claude Code 开发环境，支持按项目隔离、预置语言配置和网络防火墙控制。

desc.en: Trail of Bits' sandboxed devcontainer for running Claude Code safely in bypass-permissions mode, built for security audits and untrusted code.
desc.zh: Trail of Bits 出品的沙箱化 devcontainer，可安全地以跳过权限模式运行 Claude Code，专为安全审计和不可信代码设计。

desc.en: Kernel-enforced agent sandbox (Landlock on Linux, Seatbelt on macOS) providing zero-trust, low-overhead isolation for coding agents like Claude Code.
desc.zh: 内核级强制的代理沙箱（Linux 用 Landlock，macOS 用 Seatbelt），为 Claude Code 等编程代理提供零信任、低开销的隔离。

desc.en: macOS sandbox-exec wrapper that confines local AI agents like Claude Code so they can read and write only what they need.
desc.zh: 基于 macOS sandbox-exec 的封装工具，限制 Claude Code 等本地 AI 代理只能读写其所需的文件。

desc.en: Runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or any coding agent in clean, isolated sandboxes with sensitive-data redaction and observability.
desc.zh: 在干净、隔离的沙箱中运行 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 或任意编程代理，支持敏感数据脱敏和可观测性。

desc.en: Gives each AI coding agent its own isolated Incus machine with root, Docker and systemd, plus active threat detection.
desc.zh: 为每个 AI 编程代理分配独立的 Incus 隔离机器，具备 root、Docker 和 systemd，并提供主动威胁检测。

desc.en: Anthropic-managed multi-agent pull request review for GitHub on Team and Enterprise plans, posting verified, severity-ranked inline findings.
desc.zh: Anthropic 托管的多代理 PR 审查服务，面向 GitHub 上的 Team 与 Enterprise 套餐，发布经验证并按严重程度排序的行内问题。

desc.en: Official guide to setting up Claude Code GitHub Actions and the Claude GitHub App, with workflow examples and Bedrock/Vertex authentication.
desc.zh: 官方指南：配置 Claude Code GitHub Actions 与 Claude GitHub App，附工作流示例以及 Bedrock/Vertex 认证方式。

desc.en: Official guide to running Claude Code in GitLab CI/CD pipelines for creating merge requests, reviewing changes and handling @claude-triggered tasks.
desc.zh: 官方指南：在 GitLab CI/CD 流水线中运行 Claude Code，用于创建合并请求、审查变更和处理 @claude 触发的任务。

desc.en: Self-hostable Claude Code background agent that picks up issues from Linear, Slack, GitHub and GitLab, works in isolation and opens PRs.
desc.zh: 可自托管的 Claude Code 后台代理，从 Linear、Slack、GitHub 和 GitLab 领取任务，在隔离环境中工作并提交 PR。

desc.en: Webhook service connecting Claude Code to GitHub repositories so @mentions in issues and pull requests trigger AI-powered code assistance.
desc.zh: Webhook 服务，将 Claude Code 接入 GitHub 仓库，在 issue 和 PR 中 @ 提及即可触发 AI 代码协助。

desc.en: Gitea port of claude-code-action, enabling @claude-driven reviews and code changes in self-hosted Gitea repositories.
desc.zh: claude-code-action 的 Gitea 移植版，在自托管 Gitea 仓库中支持通过 @claude 进行审查和代码修改。

desc.en: Records every API request Claude Code makes, including system prompts and tool definitions, into a self-contained interactive HTML report.
desc.zh: 记录 Claude Code 发出的每个 API 请求（包括系统提示词和工具定义），生成独立的交互式 HTML 报告。

desc.en: DevTools-style viewer for Claude Code session logs: tool calls, token usage, subagents, thinking and context-window consumption.
desc.zh: 类 DevTools 的 Claude Code 会话日志查看器，可检查工具调用、token 用量、子代理、思考内容和上下文窗口占用。

desc.en: Python CLI converting Claude Code transcript JSONL files into readable HTML or Markdown, with project hierarchies, date filters and token stats.
desc.zh: Python CLI，将 Claude Code 对话 JSONL 文件转换为易读的 HTML 或 Markdown，支持项目层级、日期筛选和 token 统计。

desc.en: Simon Willison's tool for converting Claude Code sessions into detailed HTML pages and publishing them as shareable Gists.
desc.zh: Simon Willison 开发的工具，把 Claude Code 会话转换为详细的 HTML 页面，并可发布为可分享的 Gist。

desc.en: Real-time dashboard capturing Claude Code hook events across concurrent agents, tracing tool calls and lifecycle events via a Bun server and Vue UI.
desc.zh: 实时仪表盘，捕获多个并发 Claude Code 代理的钩子事件，通过 Bun 服务端和 Vue 界面追踪工具调用与生命周期事件。

desc.en: Docker Compose stack collecting Claude Code OpenTelemetry metrics and logs into Prometheus, Loki and Grafana dashboards for usage and cost.
desc.zh: Docker Compose 方案，将 Claude Code 的 OpenTelemetry 指标和日志汇集到 Prometheus、Loki 和 Grafana 仪表盘，监控用量与费用。

desc.en: Official guide to exporting Claude Code metrics and events via OpenTelemetry for usage, cost and tool-activity monitoring.
desc.zh: 官方指南：通过 OpenTelemetry 导出 Claude Code 的指标和事件，用于监控用量、费用和工具活动。

desc.en: Desktop app and web server to browse, search and analyze conversation history from Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding assistants.
desc.zh: 桌面应用与 Web 服务，用于浏览、搜索和分析 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程助手的对话历史。

desc.en: Intercepts and inspects API traffic from Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and other coding agents for debugging and analysis.
desc.zh: 拦截并检查 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 等编程代理的 API 流量，用于调试和分析。

desc.en: Local-first extensions and CLI that save Claude Code and other AI assistant chat histories as searchable Markdown in your project.
desc.zh: 本地优先的扩展和 CLI，将 Claude Code 等 AI 助手的聊天记录保存为项目内可搜索的 Markdown。

desc.en: Self-hosted real-time dashboard monitoring Claude Code and Codex agent activity via hooks: live sessions, subagent trees and tool-call timelines.
desc.zh: 可自托管的实时仪表盘，通过钩子监控 Claude Code 与 Codex 代理活动：实时会话、子代理树和工具调用时间线。

desc.en: Pixel desktop pet that reacts in real time to Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions, showing whether agents are thinking, working or idle.
desc.zh: 像素风桌面宠物，实时响应 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor 会话，直观显示代理正在思考、工作还是空闲。

desc.en: Official reference MCP servers (Everything, Fetch, Filesystem, Git, Memory, Sequential Thinking, Time) plus a large index of third-party servers.
desc.zh: 官方 MCP 参考服务器合集（Everything、Fetch、Filesystem、Git、Memory、Sequential Thinking、Time），并收录大量第三方服务器索引。

desc.en: Official reference server giving Claude persistent memory as a local knowledge graph of entities, relations and observations.
desc.zh: 官方参考服务器，以实体、关系和观察组成的本地知识图谱，为 Claude 提供持久记忆。

desc.en: GitHub's official MCP server for repos, issues, pull requests, Actions and code security; runs locally or as a hosted remote server.
desc.zh: GitHub 官方 MCP 服务器，支持仓库、Issue、PR、Actions 和代码安全等操作，可本地运行或使用托管远程服务。

desc.en: GitLab's built-in MCP server (beta) letting Claude and other AI tools access projects, issues, merge requests and pipelines.
desc.zh: GitLab 内置的 MCP 服务器（Beta），让 Claude 等 AI 工具访问项目、Issue、合并请求和流水线。

desc.en: Sentry's official MCP server (hosted at mcp.sentry.dev) for investigating production errors, issues, traces and root causes from your agent.
desc.zh: Sentry 官方 MCP 服务器（托管于 mcp.sentry.dev），可在智能体中排查生产错误、Issue、链路追踪与根因。

desc.en: Linear's official hosted remote MCP server with OAuth for finding, creating and updating issues, projects and comments.
desc.zh: Linear 官方托管远程 MCP 服务器，支持 OAuth，可查找、创建和更新 Issue、项目与评论。

desc.en: Official remote MCP server connecting Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket, Compass and Loom to Claude.
desc.zh: Atlassian 官方远程 MCP 服务器，将 Jira、Confluence、Jira Service Management、Bitbucket、Compass 和 Loom 接入 Claude。

desc.en: MCP server and CLI that lets agents build, run, test and debug iOS and macOS projects with Xcode and simulators.
desc.zh: 让智能体通过 Xcode 和模拟器构建、运行、测试和调试 iOS 与 macOS 项目的 MCP 服务器及 CLI。

desc.en: Platform-agnostic MCP server for automating iOS and Android apps on emulators, simulators and real devices.
desc.zh: 跨平台 MCP 服务器，可在模拟器和真机上自动化操作 iOS 与 Android 应用。

desc.en: MCP server giving Claude deep knowledge of n8n nodes and APIs so it can design, validate and deploy n8n workflows.
desc.zh: 让 Claude 深入了解 n8n 节点与 API 的 MCP 服务器，可设计、校验并部署 n8n 工作流。

desc.en: Upstash's MCP server and platform that feeds up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples into the agent's context.
desc.zh: Upstash 推出的 MCP 服务器与平台，为智能体上下文提供最新、按版本区分的库文档和代码示例。

desc.en: Free, open-source remote MCP server (gitmcp.io) that turns any GitHub project into a documentation source to curb code hallucinations.
desc.zh: 免费开源的远程 MCP 服务器（gitmcp.io），可将任意 GitHub 项目变为文档来源，减少代码幻觉。

desc.en: Official Exa MCP server for AI-native web search, code search and page crawling; available locally or hosted.
desc.zh: Exa 官方 MCP 服务器，提供面向 AI 的网页搜索、代码搜索与网页抓取，支持本地或托管使用。

desc.en: Brave's official MCP server for web, local, image, video and news search via the Brave Search API.
desc.zh: Brave 官方 MCP 服务器，通过 Brave Search API 提供网页、本地、图片、视频和新闻搜索。

desc.en: Official Tavily MCP server offering real-time web search, content extraction, site mapping and crawling for agents.
desc.zh: Tavily 官方 MCP 服务器，为智能体提供实时网页搜索、内容提取、站点地图与爬取功能。

desc.en: Official Firecrawl MCP server adding web scraping, crawling, search and structured extraction to Claude and other clients.
desc.zh: Firecrawl 官方 MCP 服务器，为 Claude 等客户端提供网页抓取、爬取、搜索和结构化提取。

desc.en: Microsoft's official browser automation MCP server using Playwright accessibility snapshots instead of screenshots for fast, deterministic control.
desc.zh: 微软官方浏览器自动化 MCP 服务器，基于 Playwright 无障碍快照而非截图，实现快速、确定性的控制。

desc.en: Official Chrome DevTools MCP server letting coding agents control and inspect live Chrome: performance traces, network, console, screenshots.
desc.zh: Chrome DevTools 官方 MCP 服务器，让编码智能体控制并检查真实 Chrome：性能追踪、网络、控制台和截图。

desc.en: Chrome extension that exposes your everyday browser, with logins and settings, as an MCP server for automation and semantic tab search.
desc.zh: Chrome 扩展，将你日常使用的浏览器（保留登录态与设置）暴露为 MCP 服务器，支持自动化和语义标签页搜索。

desc.en: Open-source Python library for AI browser agents that can also run as an MCP server for Claude Desktop and Claude Code.
desc.zh: 流行的开源 Python AI 浏览器智能体库，也可作为 MCP 服务器供 Claude Desktop 和 Claude Code 使用。

desc.en: Google's open-source MCP server for databases: BigQuery, AlloyDB, Cloud SQL, Spanner, Postgres, MySQL and more, with pooling and auth.
desc.zh: 谷歌开源的数据库 MCP 服务器，支持 BigQuery、AlloyDB、Cloud SQL、Spanner、Postgres、MySQL 等，内置连接池与认证。

desc.en: Official Supabase MCP server to manage projects, design schemas, run SQL and migrations, and deploy edge functions from Claude.
desc.zh: Supabase 官方 MCP 服务器，可在 Claude 中管理项目、设计表结构、执行 SQL 与迁移并部署 Edge Functions。

desc.en: Postgres MCP server with configurable read/write access plus index tuning, explain plans and database health analysis.
desc.zh: Postgres MCP 服务器，支持可配置的读写权限，并提供索引调优、执行计划和数据库健康分析。

desc.en: Token-efficient universal database MCP server by Bytebase for Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, MariaDB, Oracle and SQLite.
desc.zh: Bytebase 推出的省 token 通用数据库 MCP 服务器，支持 Postgres、MySQL、SQL Server、MariaDB、Oracle 和 SQLite。

desc.en: Official Neon MCP server for managing serverless Postgres projects, branches, queries and safe migrations in natural language.
desc.zh: Neon 官方 MCP 服务器，用自然语言管理 Serverless Postgres 项目、分支、查询和安全迁移。

desc.en: AWS Labs' suite of open-source MCP servers for AWS docs, APIs, CDK, EKS, serverless, cost analysis and many other services.
desc.zh: AWS Labs 开源 MCP 服务器套件，覆盖 AWS 文档、API、CDK、EKS、Serverless、成本分析等众多服务。

desc.en: Microsoft's catalog of official MCP servers, including the Azure MCP Server for managing Azure resources from agents.
desc.zh: 微软官方 MCP 服务器目录，包括可让智能体管理 Azure 资源的 Azure MCP Server。

desc.en: Google's hub of official remote and open-source MCP servers for Google Cloud, Maps, Firebase, Workspace, databases and more.
desc.zh: 谷歌官方 MCP 服务器汇总，涵盖 Google Cloud、地图、Firebase、Workspace、数据库等远程与开源服务器。

desc.en: Cloudflare's remote MCP server (mcp.cloudflare.com) exposing ~2,500 Cloudflare API endpoints through token-efficient Code Mode.
desc.zh: Cloudflare 远程 MCP 服务器（mcp.cloudflare.com），通过省 token 的 Code Mode 开放约 2500 个 Cloudflare API 端点。

desc.en: Native Go MCP server for Kubernetes and OpenShift that talks directly to the API server, no kubectl dependency.
desc.zh: 原生 Go 实现的 Kubernetes/OpenShift MCP 服务器，直接调用 API Server，无需依赖 kubectl。

desc.en: HashiCorp's official MCP server for Terraform Registry provider/module docs and HCP Terraform workspace operations.
desc.zh: HashiCorp 官方 MCP 服务器，提供 Terraform Registry Provider/模块文档查询及 HCP Terraform 工作区操作。

desc.en: Figma's official remote and desktop MCP server bringing design context, variables, components and Code Connect into coding agents.
desc.zh: Figma 官方远程及桌面版 MCP 服务器，将设计上下文、变量、组件和 Code Connect 带入编码智能体。

desc.en: Community MCP server that simplifies Figma API layout data so coding agents can implement designs accurately in one shot.
desc.zh: 社区 MCP 服务器，精简 Figma API 布局数据，帮助编码智能体一次性准确还原设计稿。

desc.en: Connects Claude to Blender via an add-on so it can create, modify and inspect 3D scenes, materials and assets by prompt.
desc.zh: 通过插件将 Claude 连接到 Blender，用提示词创建、修改和查看 3D 场景、材质与资源。

desc.en: Bridge between AI assistants and the Unity Editor to manage assets, control scenes, edit scripts and automate game dev tasks.
desc.zh: 连接 AI 助手与 Unity 编辑器的桥梁，可管理资源、控制场景、编辑脚本并自动化游戏开发任务。

desc.en: MCP server for the Godot engine: launch the editor, run projects, capture debug output and manipulate scenes.
desc.zh: Godot 引擎 MCP 服务器：可启动编辑器、运行项目、捕获调试输出并操作场景。

desc.en: Lets Claude control Ableton Live to create tracks, load instruments, arrange clips and compose music.
desc.zh: 让 Claude 控制 Ableton Live，创建音轨、加载乐器、编排片段并进行作曲。

desc.en: Official draw.io MCP server from JGraph for creating and opening diagrams in the draw.io editor, including a hosted MCP App.
desc.zh: JGraph 推出的 draw.io 官方 MCP 服务器，可在 draw.io 编辑器中创建和打开图表，并提供托管 MCP App。

desc.en: Draw and edit draw.io diagrams by chatting with AI; ships as web app, desktop app and MCP server for Claude Code.
desc.zh: 通过与 AI 对话绘制和编辑 draw.io 图表，提供 Web 应用、桌面应用以及可供 Claude Code 使用的 MCP 服务器。

desc.en: Official Excalidraw MCP App that streams editable hand-drawn diagrams directly inside Claude and other MCP Apps hosts.
desc.zh: Excalidraw 官方 MCP App，可在 Claude 等支持 MCP Apps 的客户端中直接流式生成可编辑的手绘风格图表。

desc.en: Notion's official MCP server for searching, reading and editing pages and databases; hosted remote version recommended.
desc.zh: Notion 官方 MCP 服务器，可搜索、读取和编辑页面与数据库，推荐使用托管远程版本。

desc.en: Slack's official hosted MCP server with OAuth for searching conversations, reading channels, sending messages and working with canvases.
desc.zh: Slack 官方托管 MCP 服务器，支持 OAuth，可搜索对话、读取频道、发送消息和处理 Canvas。

desc.en: Google's official remote MCP servers for Gmail, Drive, Calendar and Chat that respect each user's existing access controls.
desc.zh: 谷歌官方远程 MCP 服务器，覆盖 Gmail、Drive、Calendar 和 Chat，并沿用用户现有的访问权限。

desc.en: MCP server that reads, searches and edits notes in an Obsidian vault through the Local REST API community plugin.
desc.zh: 通过 Local REST API 社区插件读取、搜索和编辑 Obsidian 笔记库的 MCP 服务器。

desc.en: MCP server for Xiaohongshu (RedNote): log in, search, browse, comment and publish image or video notes from an agent.
desc.zh: 小红书 MCP 服务器：智能体可登录、搜索、浏览、评论并发布图文或视频笔记。

desc.en: Gives Claude terminal control, process management, file system search and diff-based file editing on your local machine.
desc.zh: 让 Claude 在本地机器上控制终端、管理进程、搜索文件系统并以 diff 方式编辑文件。

desc.en: Lightweight computer-use MCP server for Windows: launch apps, read UI trees, click, type and automate the desktop.
desc.zh: 轻量级 Windows 计算机操控 MCP 服务器：可启动应用、读取 UI 树、点击、输入并自动化桌面操作。

desc.en: macOS CLI and optional MCP server that lets agents capture screenshots, analyze them and automate GUI interactions.
desc.zh: macOS 命令行工具及可选 MCP 服务器，让智能体截取屏幕、分析画面并自动化 GUI 操作。

desc.en: AI reverse-engineering assistant bridging IDA Pro with LLMs over MCP for decompilation, renaming and binary analysis.
desc.zh: 通过 MCP 连接 IDA Pro 与大模型的 AI 逆向工程助手，支持反编译、重命名和二进制分析。

desc.en: Zep's MCP server built on Graphiti temporal knowledge graphs, giving agents persistent, queryable long-term memory.
desc.zh: Zep 基于 Graphiti 时序知识图谱构建的 MCP 服务器，为智能体提供可查询的持久长期记忆。

desc.en: Lets Claude Code consult Gemini, OpenAI, Grok, OpenRouter, Ollama and other CLIs for second opinions, consensus and code review.
desc.zh: 让 Claude Code 调用 Gemini、OpenAI、Grok、OpenRouter、Ollama 及其他 CLI，获取第二意见、达成共识并进行代码审查。

desc.en: Python library for SEC EDGAR filings (10-K, 8-K, XBRL financials, 13F) with a built-in MCP server for Claude.
desc.zh: 用于 SEC EDGAR 文件（10-K、8-K、XBRL 财务数据、13F）的 Python 库，内置可供 Claude 使用的 MCP 服务器。

desc.en: Local MCP server for literature work: search arXiv, download papers, read LaTeX sections, export BibTeX and watch topics.
desc.zh: 用于文献研究的本地 MCP 服务器：搜索 arXiv、下载论文、阅读 LaTeX 章节、导出 BibTeX 并订阅主题。

desc.en: MCP bridge letting Claude Code call Codex for implementation, debugging and review, with session persistence and parallel tasks.
desc.zh: 让 Claude Code 通过 MCP 调用 Codex 的桥接工具：Claude 负责规划与架构，Codex 负责实现、排错与审查，支持会话持久化与并行任务。

desc.en: Interactive human-in-the-loop feedback MCP server with Web UI and desktop app, letting you review and steer AI coding mid-task.
desc.zh: 交互式反馈 MCP 服务器，提供 Web 与桌面界面，让你在 AI 编码过程中随时确认、反馈和纠偏，减少无效请求；README 含简繁中文。

desc.en: Official Tier 1 Go SDK for MCP servers and clients, maintained in collaboration with Google.
desc.zh: 官方 Tier 1 级 Go SDK，用于构建 MCP 服务器和客户端，与谷歌合作维护。

desc.en: Official Tier 1 C#/.NET SDK for MCP servers and clients, maintained in collaboration with Microsoft.
desc.zh: 官方 Tier 1 级 C#/.NET SDK，用于构建 MCP 服务器和客户端，与微软合作维护。

desc.en: Official Tier 1 Rust SDK (rmcp) for building MCP servers and clients on Tokio.
desc.zh: 官方 Tier 1 级 Rust SDK（rmcp），基于 Tokio 构建 MCP 服务器和客户端。

name: Official MCP SDKs (Java, Kotlin, Swift, Ruby, PHP...)

desc.en: Index of all official MCP SDKs and their tiers, including Ruby (Tier 1), Java (Tier 2), Swift, PHP and Kotlin.
desc.zh: 所有官方 MCP SDK 及其分级的索引，包括 Ruby（Tier 1）、Java（Tier 2）、Swift、PHP 和 Kotlin。

desc.en: The fast, Pythonic framework for building MCP servers, clients and apps, with auth, proxying, composition and deployment tooling.
desc.zh: 快速、Pythonic 的 MCP 服务器、客户端与应用开发框架，提供认证、代理、组合与部署工具。

desc.en: Full-stack TypeScript/Python framework for building MCP servers, MCP Apps for Claude and ChatGPT, and MCP-powered agents.
desc.zh: 全栈 TypeScript/Python 框架，用于构建 MCP 服务器、面向 Claude 与 ChatGPT 的 MCP Apps 以及基于 MCP 的智能体。

desc.en: LastMile AI framework for building agents on MCP using composable workflow patterns from Anthropic's Building Effective Agents.
desc.zh: LastMile AI 的智能体框架，基于 MCP 并采用 Anthropic《Building Effective Agents》中的可组合工作流模式。

desc.en: Expose existing FastAPI endpoints as MCP tools with minimal configuration and built-in authentication.
desc.zh: 以极少配置将现有 FastAPI 接口暴露为 MCP 工具，并内置认证支持。

desc.en: Official visual testing and debugging tool for MCP servers; run with npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector.
desc.zh: 官方 MCP 服务器可视化测试与调试工具，可通过 npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector 运行。

desc.en: Official spec and SDK for MCP Apps, the extension letting MCP servers render interactive UIs inside Claude, ChatGPT and other hosts.
desc.zh: MCP Apps 官方规范与 SDK，该扩展让 MCP 服务器在 Claude、ChatGPT 等客户端中渲染交互式界面。

desc.en: Packaging format and CLI for one-click installable local MCP servers in Claude Desktop and other apps (formerly Desktop Extensions/DXT).
desc.zh: 将本地 MCP 服务器打包为可在 Claude Desktop 等应用中一键安装的格式及 CLI（原 Desktop Extensions/DXT）。

desc.en: Docker's catalog of containerized MCP servers plus Toolkit and open-source MCP Gateway for securely running and connecting them to Claude.
desc.zh: Docker 的容器化 MCP 服务器目录，配合 Toolkit 和开源 MCP Gateway，安全地运行这些服务器并接入 Claude。

desc.en: IBM's open-source gateway, registry and proxy federating MCP servers, A2A agents and REST/gRPC APIs with governance and observability.
desc.zh: IBM 开源网关、注册表与代理，统一接入 MCP 服务器、A2A 智能体及 REST/gRPC API，并提供治理与可观测性。

desc.en: Security scanner for MCP servers, agent configs and skills detecting tool poisoning, prompt injection and rug-pull attacks.
desc.zh: 面向 MCP 服务器、智能体配置和技能的安全扫描器，可检测工具投毒、提示词注入和 rug pull 攻击。

desc.en: Microsoft's open-source MCP curriculum with hands-on lessons and examples in Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, Rust and more.
desc.zh: 微软开源的 MCP 课程，提供 Python、TypeScript、Java、C#、Rust 等语言的实操课程和示例。

desc.en: The official, open MCP server registry with namespace-verified server.json metadata and an API that downstream registries build on.
desc.zh: 官方开放的 MCP 服务器注册中心，采用命名空间验证的 server.json 元数据，并提供供下游注册表使用的 API。

desc.en: Anthropic's directory of Anthropic-reviewed remote MCP connectors and plugins installable across Claude, Claude Desktop and Claude Code.
desc.zh: Anthropic 的连接器目录，收录经其审核的远程 MCP 连接器与插件，可在 Claude、Claude Desktop 和 Claude Code 中安装。

desc.en: GitHub's curated registry of MCP servers with one-click install into VS Code and other MCP clients.
desc.zh: GitHub 精选的 MCP 服务器注册表，支持一键安装到 VS Code 等 MCP 客户端。

desc.en: Large MCP registry and marketplace with hosted servers, a CLI installer and managed auth connections; now part of Arcade.dev.
desc.zh: 大型 MCP 注册与市场平台，提供托管服务器、CLI 安装器和托管认证连接，现已并入 Arcade.dev。

desc.en: Searchable MCP server directory with automated security, license and quality scoring, plus hosted gateway and inspection tools.
desc.zh: 可搜索的 MCP 服务器目录，提供自动化的安全、许可证和质量评分，以及托管网关和检测工具。

desc.en: MCP directory and weekly newsletter tracking servers, clients and use cases with estimated usage-based popularity rankings.
desc.zh: MCP 目录与每周通讯，追踪服务器、客户端和用例，并按估算使用量给出热度排名。

desc.en: One of the largest community MCP server directories, with categories, rankings and an open-source codebase (chatmcp/mcpso).
desc.zh: 规模最大的社区 MCP 服务器目录之一，提供分类与排行，代码开源（chatmcp/mcpso）。

desc.en: MCP server marketplace and directory with categories, daily leaderboards and client setup guides.
desc.zh: MCP 服务器市场与目录，提供分类、每日排行榜和客户端配置指南。

desc.en: Curated list of MCP servers, organized by category with language and deployment badges.
desc.zh: 星标最多的 MCP 服务器精选列表，按类别整理并标注语言与部署方式。

desc.en: Chinese-language curated collection of MCP resources, guides, servers and clients, including Claude MCP setup tips.
desc.zh: 中文 MCP 资源精选合集，涵盖指南、服务器、客户端以及 Claude MCP 配置技巧。

name: 魔搭 ModelScope MCP 广场

desc.en: ModelScope's MCP marketplace: browse and host MCP servers usable from Claude and other clients, popular in China.
desc.zh: 魔搭社区 MCP 广场：国内最大的 MCP 服务聚合与托管平台之一，可在 Claude 等客户端中直接接入。

desc.en: Open-source desktop app and headless server from Craft for multitasking with AI agents, built on the Claude Agent SDK alongside the Pi SDK.
desc.zh: Craft 出品的开源桌面应用与无头服务器，用于多任务协同 AI 智能体；基于 Claude Agent SDK 与 Pi SDK 构建。

desc.en: Open-source Claude Cowork-style desktop chat app powered by the Claude Agent SDK, automating work across 500+ SaaS apps via Composio.
desc.zh: 开源的类 Claude Cowork 桌面聊天应用，基于 Claude Agent SDK，通过 Composio 在 500+ SaaS 应用间自动化工作。

desc.en: Autonomous AI pentester for web apps and APIs: analyzes source code, then runs real exploits to prove vulnerabilities; Anthropic is a built-in provider.
desc.zh: 面向 Web 应用和 API 的自主 AI 渗透测试工具：先分析源码，再执行真实漏洞利用来验证漏洞；内置 Anthropic 模型支持。

desc.en: Self-hosted, agent-driven video workspace turning novels and scripts into characters, storyboards and short videos, with cross-shot consistency and cost tracking.
desc.zh: 自托管的智能体驱动视频工作台，可将小说和剧本转化为角色、分镜与短视频，支持跨镜头一致性与费用追踪。

desc.en: Runs the Claude Agent SDK (Claude Code) inside a sandbox, such as an E2B template, and lets you control it remotely over WebSocket.
desc.zh: 在沙箱（如 E2B 模板）中运行 Claude Agent SDK（Claude Code），并通过 WebSocket 远程控制。

name: AI SDK Provider for Claude Code

desc.en: Community Vercel AI SDK provider that routes generateText/streamText calls through the Claude Agent SDK, reusing Claude Code's tools and authentication.
desc.zh: 社区版 Vercel AI SDK 提供程序，将 generateText/streamText 调用经由 Claude Agent SDK 执行，复用 Claude Code 的工具与认证。

desc.en: Open-source template for a personal agent you text over iMessage, running on the Claude Agent SDK (or Codex) with memory, sub-agents and automations.
desc.zh: 可通过 iMessage 发消息交互的个人智能体开源模板，基于 Claude Agent SDK（或 Codex）运行，具备记忆、子智能体与自动化能力。

desc.en: Autonomous AI co-worker built on the Claude Agent SDK that runs on its own dedicated machine, with persistent memory, self-improvement and an MCP server.
desc.zh: 基于 Claude Agent SDK 的自主 AI 同事，运行在独立的专用机器上，具备持久记忆、自我改进能力并提供 MCP 服务器。

desc.en: Cross-platform agent framework for multi-user chat scenarios, combining Claude Code sandbox execution, workspace orchestration, long-term memory and MCP management.
desc.zh: 面向多人互动场景的跨平台智能体框架，集成 Claude Code 沙盒执行、工作区编排、长期记忆与 MCP 管理。

desc.en: Self-hosted personal AI assistant you control from chat apps; started as 'Clawdbot' built around Claude, now multi-model.
desc.zh: 极受欢迎的自托管个人 AI 助手，可通过聊天应用操控；最初以围绕 Claude 打造的「Clawdbot」起家，现已支持多模型。

desc.en: Anthropic's reference implementation of Claude computer use: Dockerized Linux desktop, agent loop and Streamlit UI; works with the Claude API, Bedrock or Vertex.
desc.zh: Anthropic 官方的 Claude 计算机使用参考实现：Docker 化的 Linux 桌面、智能体循环与 Streamlit 界面，支持 Claude API、Bedrock 或 Vertex。

desc.en: Browserbase's SDK (TypeScript, Python, Go) for AI browser automation with act/extract/observe primitives and an agent mode that works with Claude models.
desc.zh: Browserbase 推出的 AI 浏览器自动化 SDK（TypeScript/Python/Go），提供 act/extract/observe 原语及可搭配 Claude 模型的智能体模式。

desc.en: Open-source computer-use infrastructure: cross-OS sandboxes and VMs, drivers and benchmarks, with an agent SDK supporting Claude computer-use models.
desc.zh: 开源的计算机使用基础设施：跨操作系统的沙箱与虚拟机、驱动与基准测试，并提供支持 Claude 计算机使用模型的智能体 SDK。

desc.en: Simular's open agentic framework for GUI computer use (Agent S3, strong OSWorld results); Anthropic is a supported main-model provider.
desc.zh: Simular 推出的开放式 GUI 计算机使用智能体框架（Agent S3，OSWorld 成绩突出）；主模型可选用 Anthropic。

desc.en: Open-source, vision-first browser agent that acts on pixels rather than the DOM; recommends Claude Sonnet for best performance.
desc.zh: 开源、以视觉为先的浏览器智能体，基于像素而非 DOM 进行操作；官方推荐使用 Claude Sonnet 以获得最佳效果。

desc.en: Open-source Chrome/Edge extension running AI web automation in your real, logged-in browser, with bring-your-own-key Anthropic, OpenAI and other models.
desc.zh: 开源的 Chrome/Edge 扩展，在你已登录的真实浏览器中运行 AI 网页自动化，可自带 Anthropic、OpenAI 等模型的密钥。

desc.en: Automates browser-based workflows using LLMs and computer vision; supports Claude models via Anthropic and AWS Bedrock.
desc.zh: 结合大模型与计算机视觉自动化浏览器工作流；通过 Anthropic 与 AWS Bedrock 支持 Claude 模型。

desc.en: Out-of-the-box GUI agent for Windows and macOS from NUS Show Lab, running Claude computer use locally without a Docker VM.
desc.zh: 新加坡国立大学 Show Lab 推出的开箱即用 Windows/macOS GUI 智能体，无需 Docker 虚拟机即可在本地运行 Claude 计算机使用。

desc.en: Minimal Electron app that lets Claude computer use drive your own desktop directly instead of a sandboxed VM.
desc.zh: 极简的 Electron 应用，让 Claude 计算机使用功能直接操控你自己的桌面，而非沙箱虚拟机。

desc.en: Fork of Anthropic's computer-use demo that runs natively on macOS, letting Claude control a Mac without a Docker Linux VM.
desc.zh: Anthropic 计算机使用演示的分支，可在 macOS 上原生运行，让 Claude 无需 Docker Linux 虚拟机即可操控 Mac。

desc.en: Autonomous coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains and the terminal, originally 'Claude Dev'; Claude is a first-class model, with plan/act modes and MCP.
desc.zh: 适用于 VS Code、JetBrains 与终端的自主编程智能体，前身为「Claude Dev」；Claude 是其一等支持模型，具备 Plan/Act 模式与 MCP 支持。

desc.en: Open-source coding agent (terminal TUI, desktop, IDE) from the SST/Anomaly team; provider-agnostic with strong Claude support.
desc.zh: 极受欢迎的开源编程智能体（终端 TUI、桌面端与 IDE），由 SST/Anomaly 团队打造；不绑定模型服务商，对 Claude 支持良好。

desc.en: AI pair-programming CLI that edits your git repo directly; long a top performer with Claude, and home of the Aider LLM leaderboards.
desc.zh: 开创性的终端 AI 结对编程工具，可直接编辑 git 仓库；长期搭配 Claude 表现出色，并维护 Aider 大模型排行榜。

desc.en: Open platform for autonomous software-development agents (formerly OpenDevin) with CLI, GUI, cloud and SDK; Claude models are among its recommended LLMs.
desc.zh: 面向自主软件开发智能体的开放平台（前身 OpenDevin），提供 CLI、GUI、云端与 SDK；Claude 系列是其推荐使用的模型之一。

desc.en: Extensible open-source on-machine AI agent (desktop and CLI) that installs, edits, runs and tests code; supports Anthropic and Claude subscriptions via ACP.
desc.zh: 可扩展的开源本地 AI 智能体（桌面端与 CLI），能安装、编辑、运行与测试代码；支持 Anthropic API，也可通过 ACP 使用 Claude 订阅。

desc.en: Open-source agentic engineering platform for VS Code, JetBrains and CLI, descended from Cline/Roo Code, with hundreds of models including Claude.
desc.zh: 开源的智能体工程平台，支持 VS Code、JetBrains 与 CLI，源自 Cline/Roo Code，可使用包括 Claude 在内的数百种模型。

desc.en: Charm's glamorous terminal coding agent with LSP integration, MCP and multi-session support; works with Anthropic Claude among many providers.
desc.zh: Charm 出品的精美终端编程智能体，集成 LSP、MCP 并支持多会话；兼容 Anthropic Claude 等众多服务商。

desc.en: Open-source coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains and CI checks, with configurable models and rules; Claude is a popular first-class choice.
desc.zh: 面向 VS Code、JetBrains 与 CI 检查的开源编程智能体，模型与规则可配置；Claude 是常用的一等支持模型。

desc.en: High-performance Rust code editor with a built-in agent panel; runs Claude via API or Claude Code through the Agent Client Protocol.
desc.zh: 高性能 Rust 代码编辑器，内置智能体面板；可通过 API 使用 Claude，或借助 Agent Client Protocol 运行 Claude Code。

desc.en: Minimal, extensible terminal coding agent plus agent toolkit (unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI) with Anthropic among its built-in providers.
desc.zh: 极简、可扩展的终端编程智能体及智能体工具包（统一 LLM API、智能体循环、TUI），内置 Anthropic 等服务商支持。

desc.en: Neovim plugin emulating the Cursor AI IDE experience with chat, diffs and agentic edits applied in-buffer; Claude is the default provider.
desc.zh: 在 Neovim 中复刻 Cursor AI IDE 体验的插件，支持对话、差异预览与智能体式编辑；默认提供商为 Claude。

desc.en: AI coding plugin for Neovim with chat, inline edits and agents; supports Anthropic natively and Claude Code via the Agent Client Protocol.
desc.zh: Neovim 的 AI 编程插件，提供聊天、行内编辑与智能体功能；原生支持 Anthropic，并可通过 ACP 接入 Claude Code。

desc.en: Simple, extensible LLM client for Emacs that works in any buffer, with first-class Anthropic Claude support including tool use.
desc.zh: 简洁、可扩展的 Emacs 大模型客户端，可在任意缓冲区使用，原生支持 Anthropic Claude（含工具调用）。

desc.en: Early, influential Claude-powered interactive CLI that creates and edits files, runs code and can even write new tools for itself.
desc.zh: 早期颇具影响力的 Claude 驱动交互式 CLI，能创建和编辑文件、运行代码，甚至为自身编写新工具。

desc.en: Open-source core of StackBlitz's bolt.new: prompt, run, edit and deploy full-stack apps in the browser via WebContainers, originally powered by Claude.
desc.zh: StackBlitz bolt.new 的开源核心：基于 WebContainers 在浏览器中通过提示词运行、编辑并部署全栈应用，最初由 Claude 驱动。

desc.en: Local, open-source AI app builder (v0/Lovable/Bolt alternative) that runs on your machine with your own API keys for Claude and other models.
desc.zh: 本地运行的开源 AI 应用构建器（v0/Lovable/Bolt 替代品），使用你自己的 API 密钥调用 Claude 等模型。

desc.en: Open-source Claude Code-style terminal agent supporting 20+ model providers, compatible with CLAUDE.md files and .claude directories.
desc.zh: 开源的 Claude Code 风格终端智能体，支持 20+ 模型服务商，兼容 CLAUDE.md 文件与 .claude 目录。

desc.en: Open-source Next.js template for Claude Artifacts-style apps fully generated by AI, executing code safely in E2B sandboxes; supports Anthropic and other models.
desc.zh: 开源 Next.js 模板，可构建类似 Claude Artifacts、完全由 AI 生成的应用，并在 E2B 沙箱中安全执行代码；支持 Anthropic 等模型。

desc.en: Self-hostable multi-provider ChatGPT-style interface with agents, MCP, skills and artifacts; native Anthropic endpoint for Claude, plus Bedrock and Vertex.
desc.zh: 可自托管的多服务商 ChatGPT 风格界面，支持智能体、MCP、Skills 与 Artifacts；原生 Anthropic 端点支持 Claude，并支持 Bedrock 与 Vertex。

desc.en: Open-source AI agent workspace (formerly LobeChat) with multi-provider chat, agent teams, MCP plugins and knowledge bases; supports Claude natively.
