desc.zh: 开源 AI 智能体工作空间（前身 LobeChat），支持多服务商聊天、智能体团队、MCP 插件与知识库，原生支持 Claude。

desc.en: Self-hosted AI interface; connects to Claude via Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or pipe functions for full Messages API features.
desc.zh: 星标数最多的自托管 AI 界面；可通过 Anthropic 的 OpenAI 兼容端点接入 Claude，或借助 Pipe 函数使用完整的 Messages API 功能。

desc.en: Cross-platform desktop AI productivity studio with unified access to Claude and other frontier models, autonomous agents, MCP and 300+ assistants.
desc.zh: 跨平台桌面 AI 生产力工作室，统一接入 Claude 等前沿模型，提供自主智能体、MCP 与 300+ 助手。

desc.en: Lightweight cross-platform AI chat app (web, desktop, mobile) with one-click deployment; supports Claude alongside GPT, Gemini and others.
desc.zh: 轻量级跨平台 AI 聊天应用（Web、桌面与移动端），支持一键部署；兼容 Claude 以及 GPT、Gemini 等模型。

desc.en: Desktop and mobile AI client supporting Claude, GPT, Gemini and local models, with knowledge bases, MCP tools and image generation.
desc.zh: 流行的桌面与移动端 AI 客户端，支持 Claude、GPT、Gemini 与本地模型，具备知识库、MCP 工具与图像生成功能。

desc.en: Open-source, offline-first ChatGPT alternative for running local models, with optional remote providers including Anthropic Claude.
desc.zh: 开源、离线优先的 ChatGPT 替代品，可运行本地模型，也可选接入 Anthropic Claude 等远程服务商。

desc.en: All-in-one, local-first AI app for chatting with documents, RAG and agent workflows; Anthropic Claude is a supported LLM provider.
desc.zh: 一体化、本地优先的 AI 应用，支持文档对话、RAG 与智能体工作流；可选择 Anthropic Claude 作为模型服务商。

desc.en: Power-user AI suite with multi-model 'Beam' comparisons, personas and voice, featuring first-class Anthropic Claude support.
desc.zh: 面向高级用户的 AI 套件，支持多模型「Beam」对比、角色与语音，并一等支持 Anthropic Claude。

desc.en: Self-hostable AI second brain that answers from the web or your documents, with custom agents and research mode; supports Claude models.
desc.zh: 可自托管的 AI「第二大脑」，基于网络或个人文档作答，支持自定义智能体与研究模式；可使用 Claude 模型。

desc.en: Unofficial Linux packaging of Claude Desktop, now repackaging Anthropic's official beta .deb into RPM, AppImage, AUR and Nix builds with Linux fixes.
desc.zh: Claude Desktop 的非官方 Linux 打包项目，现基于 Anthropic 官方测试版 .deb 重新打包为 RPM、AppImage、AUR 与 Nix 等格式，并附带 Linux 修复。

desc.en: Plugin for Simon Willison's LLM command-line tool adding Claude models, extended thinking and server-side tools such as web search and code execution.
desc.zh: Simon Willison 的 LLM 命令行工具插件，加入 Claude 模型、扩展思考以及网页搜索、代码执行等服务端工具。

desc.en: All-in-one Rust LLM CLI with shell assistant, chat REPL, RAG, tools and agents; supports Claude among 20+ providers.
desc.zh: 一体化 Rust 大模型命令行工具，提供 Shell 助手、聊天 REPL、RAG、工具与智能体；支持 Claude 等 20+ 服务商。

desc.en: Desktop AI assistant and universal MCP client with bring-your-own-key access to Claude and other models, prompt-anywhere commands and agents.
desc.zh: 桌面 AI 助手与通用 MCP 客户端，可自带密钥使用 Claude 等模型，支持随处调用的提示命令与智能体。

desc.en: Cross-platform desktop AI assistant and MCP client compatible with major providers including Anthropic, with a local knowledge base and prompt library.
desc.zh: 跨平台桌面 AI 助手与 MCP 客户端，兼容 Anthropic 等主流服务商，内置本地知识库与提示词库。

desc.en: Open-source desktop AI assistant connecting Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and local models, with MCP tool calling and multi-window chats.
desc.zh: 开源桌面 AI 助手，连接 Claude、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek 与本地模型，支持 MCP 工具调用和多窗口对话。

desc.en: Raycast extension for asking Claude from the macOS command bar with your Anthropic API key: model picker, continued conversations, saved answers, selected-text input.
desc.zh: Raycast 扩展，使用你的 Anthropic API 密钥在 macOS 命令栏中向 Claude 提问：支持模型选择、继续对话、保存回答与读取选中文本。

desc.en: High-performance Rust inference API and chat UI that feeds DeepSeek R1's chain-of-thought reasoning into Claude for the final answer.
desc.zh: 高性能 Rust 推理 API 与聊天界面，将 DeepSeek R1 的思维链推理输入 Claude 以生成最终答案。

desc.en: @ai-sdk/anthropic: TypeScript Claude provider for the Vercel AI SDK, covering prompt caching, thinking, batches, MCP connectors and server tools like web search.
desc.zh: @ai-sdk/anthropic：Vercel AI SDK 中的 Claude TypeScript 提供程序，支持提示缓存、思考、批处理、MCP 连接器以及网页搜索等服务端工具。

desc.en: langchain-anthropic integration: ChatAnthropic with tool calling, structured output, PDF/image input, extended thinking, prompt caching and Claude's built-in tools.
desc.zh: langchain-anthropic 集成：ChatAnthropic 支持工具调用、结构化输出、PDF/图像输入、扩展思考、提示缓存及 Claude 内置工具。

desc.en: llama-index-llms-anthropic: use Claude in LlamaIndex with streaming, multimodal input, prompt caching, tool calling, structured prediction and citations.
desc.zh: llama-index-llms-anthropic：在 LlamaIndex 中使用 Claude，支持流式输出、多模态输入、提示缓存、工具调用、结构化预测与引用。

desc.en: AI gateway and Python SDK calling 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI format, with Anthropic support, cost tracking, prompt-caching injection and load balancing.
desc.zh: AI 网关与 Python SDK，以 OpenAI 格式调用 100+ 大模型 API，支持 Anthropic、成本追踪、提示缓存注入与负载均衡。

desc.en: Open-source CLI for testing prompts, agents and RAG, plus AI red-teaming; ships first-class Anthropic and Claude Agent SDK providers.
desc.zh: 开源 CLI，用于测试提示词、智能体与 RAG 并进行 AI 红队测试；提供一等支持的 Anthropic 与 Claude Agent SDK 提供程序。

desc.en: UK AI Security Institute's framework for LLM evaluations, covering benchmarks, agentic tasks and sandboxes, with a native Anthropic provider.
desc.zh: 英国 AI 安全研究所推出的大模型评测框架，涵盖基准测试、智能体任务与沙箱，原生支持 Anthropic。

desc.en: Structured outputs for LLMs via Pydantic models with validation and retries; supports Anthropic Claude through tool-based extraction.
desc.zh: 基于 Pydantic 模型为大模型提供结构化输出，带校验与重试；通过工具调用方式支持 Anthropic Claude。

desc.en: Andrew Ng's simple, unified Python interface to many generative AI providers, letting you swap Claude and other models by changing one string.
desc.zh: 吴恩达推出的简洁统一 Python 接口，可对接多家生成式 AI 服务商，只需修改一个字符串即可切换 Claude 等模型。

desc.en: Token counting and price estimation for 400+ LLMs, using Anthropic's token-counting API for newer Claude models.
desc.zh: 为 400+ 大模型提供 token 计数与费用估算，较新的 Claude 模型使用 Anthropic 的 token 计数 API。

desc.en: Modular Rust library for building LLM applications and agents, with an Anthropic Claude provider alongside OpenAI, Gemini and others.
desc.zh: 用于构建大模型应用与智能体的模块化 Rust 库，提供 Anthropic Claude 以及 OpenAI、Gemini 等提供程序。

desc.en: Elegant Ruby AI framework offering one API for chat, tools, vision, embeddings and Rails integration across Claude and other providers.
desc.zh: 优雅的 Ruby AI 框架，以统一 API 提供聊天、工具、视觉、嵌入与 Rails 集成，支持 Claude 等服务商。

desc.en: Unified Laravel/PHP interface for working with LLMs, including a full-featured Anthropic provider for Claude with tools and structured output.
desc.zh: 面向 Laravel/PHP 的统一大模型接口，包含功能完善的 Anthropic Claude 提供程序，支持工具与结构化输出。

desc.en: Tidyverse R package for calling LLM APIs, with chat_anthropic() for Claude, tool calling, structured data extraction and streaming.
desc.zh: Tidyverse 出品的 R 语言大模型 API 调用包，提供 chat_anthropic() 接入 Claude，支持工具调用、结构化数据提取与流式输出。

desc.en: Pure Dart/Flutter client for the Anthropic API with streaming and tool use, from the langchain_dart / ai_clients_dart family.
desc.zh: 纯 Dart/Flutter 的 Anthropic API 客户端，支持流式输出与工具调用，属于 langchain_dart / ai_clients_dart 系列。

desc.en: Open-source Swift package for the Anthropic API, letting iOS and macOS apps use Claude messages, streaming, vision and tool use.
desc.zh: 开源 Swift 包，让 iOS 与 macOS 应用对接 Anthropic API，使用 Claude 消息、流式输出、视觉与工具调用。

desc.en: Unofficial C#/.NET SDK for the Claude API with streaming, tool calling, batches and Microsoft.Extensions.AI integration.
desc.zh: 流行的非官方 C#/.NET Claude API SDK，支持流式输出、工具调用、批处理及 Microsoft.Extensions.AI 集成。

desc.en: LangChain-style framework for integrating LLMs into Elixir apps, with ChatAnthropic support for Claude, extended thinking and AWS Bedrock.
desc.zh: LangChain 风格的 Elixir 框架，用于在 Elixir 应用中集成大模型，支持 ChatAnthropic（Claude）、扩展思考与 AWS Bedrock。

desc.en: Collection of Claude Code best practices, from prompting and CLAUDE.md to skills, subagents, hooks and debugging.
desc.zh: 极受欢迎的 Claude Code 最佳实践合集，涵盖提示、CLAUDE.md、技能、子代理、钩子与调试。

desc.en: Visual, example-driven Claude Code guide with a level-based learning path and copy-paste templates for commands, skills, hooks and MCP.
desc.zh: 图文并茂、示例驱动的 Claude Code 指南，提供分级学习路径以及命令、技能、钩子、MCP 的可复制模板。

desc.en: Hands-on course building a nano Claude Code-like agent harness from scratch in Python, one mechanism per lesson; English, Chinese, Japanese.
desc.zh: 动手课程：用 Python 从零构建迷你版 Claude Code 智能体框架，每课新增一个机制；提供英/中/日文版。

desc.en: 45+ practical Claude Code tips from basics to advanced, including a custom status line script and running Claude Code in containers.
desc.zh: 45 条以上从入门到进阶的 Claude Code 实用技巧，含自定义状态栏脚本和在容器中运行 Claude Code。

desc.en: Very comprehensive Claude Code guide covering agentic workflows, hooks, skills, MCP, quizzes and production-ready templates.
desc.zh: 非常全面的 Claude Code 指南，涵盖智能体工作流、钩子、技能、MCP、测验与可用于生产的模板。

desc.en: Community guide to Claude Code setup, commands, workflows, agents, skills and tips, from beginner to power user.
desc.zh: 社区版 Claude Code 指南，覆盖安装、命令、工作流、智能体、技能与技巧，适合新手到高阶用户。

desc.en: Independent community knowledge base of Claude Code docs, tutorials, mechanics and best practices drawn from real-world usage.
desc.zh: 独立社区知识库，汇集源于实战的 Claude Code 文档、教程、机制解析与最佳实践。

desc.en: Template and walkthrough for context engineering with Claude Code: INITIAL.md specs, PRP generation, examples and CLAUDE.md rules.
desc.zh: 用于 Claude Code 上下文工程的模板与教程：INITIAL.md 需求、PRP 生成、示例与 CLAUDE.md 规则。

desc.en: Korean-language book-style guide to mastering Claude Code, published openly on GitHub Pages.
desc.zh: 韩文的书籍式 Claude Code 进阶指南，通过 GitHub Pages 公开发布。

desc.en: Korean beginner guide to Claude Code (with English content), built as a Next.js site; also localized to Japanese.
desc.zh: 韩文 Claude Code 入门指南（含英文内容），基于 Next.js 构建，并已有日文本地化版本。

desc.en: Anthropic's foundational essay on agent design: workflows vs agents, prompt chaining, routing, orchestrator-workers, evaluator-optimizer; favor simplicity.
desc.zh: Anthropic 智能体设计奠基文章：区分工作流与智能体，介绍提示链、路由、编排-执行、评估-优化等模式，强调简洁。

name: Effective Context Engineering for AI Agents

desc.en: Anthropic on curating the smallest high-signal context for agents: system prompts, tools, just-in-time retrieval, compaction, notes and subagents.
desc.zh: Anthropic 谈如何为智能体打造精简高信号的上下文：系统提示、工具、即时检索、压缩、笔记与子代理。

name: Writing Effective Tools for Agents — with Agents

desc.en: How to design, evaluate and iteratively improve agent tools and MCP servers, using Claude itself to optimize tool descriptions.
desc.zh: 如何设计、评测并迭代优化智能体工具与 MCP 服务器，并借助 Claude 自身改进工具描述。

name: Equipping Agents for the Real World with Agent Skills

desc.en: Engineering announcement explaining Agent Skills: SKILL.md folders, progressive disclosure, bundled code, and how to author skills.
desc.zh: 介绍 Agent Skills 的工程文章：SKILL.md 文件夹、渐进式披露、附带代码以及如何编写技能。

desc.en: Anthropic's patterns for agents working across many context windows: initializer agents, progress files, feature lists, incremental verified work.
desc.zh: Anthropic 关于跨多个上下文窗口持续工作的智能体框架模式：初始化代理、进度文件、功能清单与增量验证。

desc.en: Presenting MCP tools as code APIs so agents write code to call them, cutting token usage and improving efficiency.
desc.zh: 将 MCP 工具呈现为代码 API，让智能体编写代码调用，从而大幅减少 token 消耗、提升效率。

name: Building Agents with the Claude Agent SDK

desc.en: Why the Claude Code SDK became the Agent SDK, its gather-context/act/verify loop, and best practices for building agents.
desc.zh: 解释 Claude Code SDK 更名为 Agent SDK 的原因、“收集上下文-行动-验证”循环以及构建智能体的最佳实践。

name: A Harness for Every Task: Dynamic Workflows in Claude Code

desc.en: Claude Code team on dynamic workflows that spawn and coordinate subagents, with six patterns like fan-out, adversarial verification and tournaments.
desc.zh: Claude Code 团队介绍动态工作流：生成并协调子代理，含扇出汇总、对抗验证、锦标赛等六种模式。

name: How Anthropic Teams Use Claude Code

desc.en: Case study of how Anthropic's engineering, security, data, legal, marketing and other teams use Claude Code day to day.
desc.zh: 案例研究：Anthropic 的工程、安全、数据、法务、市场等团队如何在日常工作中使用 Claude Code。

desc.en: Flask creator Armin Ronacher's practical Claude Code workflow: tool design, logging, language choice, simplicity and parallelizing agent work.
desc.zh: Flask 作者 Armin Ronacher 分享的 Claude Code 实战工作流：工具设计、日志、语言选择、保持简单与并行化。

name: How I Use Every Claude Code Feature (Shrivu Shankar)

desc.en: Reference-style tour of nearly every Claude Code feature — CLAUDE.md, context, hooks, skills, MCP, SDK, GitHub Actions — and which to avoid.
desc.zh: 参考手册式长文，逐一讲解几乎所有 Claude Code 功能（CLAUDE.md、上下文、钩子、技能、MCP、SDK、GitHub Actions）及应避免的用法。

desc.en: Widely cited guide: keep CLAUDE.md short and universal, point to docs instead of embedding them, leave style to linters.
desc.zh: 广受引用的指南：保持 CLAUDE.md 简短通用，用指向文档代替内嵌内容，把代码风格交给 linter。

name: What Makes Claude Code So Damn Good (MinusX)

desc.en: Analysis of Claude Code's design — single control loop, small helper models, detailed prompts, LLM search over RAG, self-managed todos.
desc.zh: 剖析 Claude Code 的设计：单一主循环、小模型辅助、详尽提示、以 LLM 搜索替代 RAG、模型自维护待办列表。

name: Ralph Wiggum as a "Software Engineer" (Geoffrey Huntley)
